Now the good part! My iced coffee was strong and flavorful. I'm interested in trying their other coffee offerings and homemade chai. I ordered the eggs benedict waffle and my friend ordered the chili waffle. The waffle itself was great. It had that great malty flavor and was nice and fluffy inside. I would have been satisfied with that alone. Then you put one of my favorite breakfast items atop that delicious waffle and you've got one happy girl. I would have liked a bit more hollandaise, but that's just my preference. The portion was just right. My bff got the chili waffle which was delicious. The chili had a variety of beans and veggies with just the right amount of spice - flavorful on the front with a heat that catches you on the back end. We got a side order of homefries that were so tasty and perfectly seasoned. 

The weekend dinner specials were on the wall and they all sounded great. I'll definitely be back.

Chhaya is a good breakfast, brunch & coffee spot except for one thing, they play bad music too loudly.  If you're trying to talk to someone you have to speak louder than should be necessary, and it makes it difficult to think or relex.  Chhaya is hardly the only place that plays music that is probably meant primarily for the staff louder than patrons may want it, but it does not make it a good practice.  Otherwise, the food and prices are all good.

Aside from Smokes and MarBar, this was the most convenient bar for me when I went to Penn, and yet NONE of my classmates went there. It was taboo. 

I still went, though, from time to time. It's a pretty fun group of Drexel kids on the weekends, and the cover is low (when they have one). The ambiance is dive-barish, but you won't pay an arm and a leg for a drink either. It's also a decent place to watch big sports games. 

The layout is a little awkward, honestly. You're either standing around the bar or you feel like you're on a separate planet, and the "dance floor" makes absolutely no sense for dancing.
This is my favorite pizza in town. The white pizza is... just... *drools*

They mess up your order and don't want to exchange when they clearly didn't get your meal right. Would you want salt pepper and ketchup on your rice? If you asked for the chicken with salt, pepper, ketchup and hot sauce in separate bags, they'll tell you you meant EACH WHOLE MEAL in one place-- in separate plastic bags???

It's hard to find a pizza joint that doesn't claim the fresh ingredients, however, Pizza Luna ingredients delivers in the taste. It is clearly handmade goods. My wife and I started with salads - Caesar & Simple Greens both were unique and dare I say fresh. As a personal note, I liked both dressings, however, it was just too much quantity for my taste - next time half dressing or on the side. We chose the Merguez Pizza for our main course featuring Mediterranean Style Lamb with Pesto, Onions, Fontina & Feta Cheese. The thin crust was baked to perfection and the overall taste was superb. The small version was perfect for (2) peoples. There was nice seating both inside and out on a small patio. The assortment of lighting made for a pleasant environment. I'll be back soon. I highly recommend you do the same.

We entered a half empty restaurant on a Friday at 1pm and after a long wait to find our waitress, we informed her we needed to leave by 1:35 for an appointment.  We promptly ordered and after about 15 minutes I saw the food at the counter waiting for our waitress.  She was nowhere to be found.  In fact not a single person on the wait staff was on the floor (someone's birthday?).  After 5 minutes I went up to the counter myself and brought the sandwiches we ordered to our table.  They were served on flat plates which may have been stylish but totally impractical.  The table was so small I moved the condiments to the next table so we'd have some room.  When I got the bill it said "18% gratuity suggested" but failed to state how much that was.  What restaurant doesn't give you 3 + choices for the tip % and then spell out how much that is?  Sandwich was ok, but overpriced and why all the drama?  The space is cute  with big windows.  The outside seating looked nice but the Paris cafe chairs are completely impractical for an elderly person.  Side note - the restaurant is across from a major hospital and down the street from a leading eye hospital, so elderly folks will be eating here. 

Bottom line:  budget your time, practice your waitressing skills beforehand and for gods sake make sure to take your Xanax before you get there.

Absolutely wonderful.  Right in the Trader Joe's shopping center.   Pretty tiny dine-in.  The aromas outside the door were amazing and even better when we stepped inside.  Great service from general manager, Gabriel.   Very interesting pizza topping choices.  Very creative.  We order 4 different pizzas and could not decide which one we liked the best - they were all four winners!!  Everything was delicious.  We will definitely be back to try some of their other combinations!!  Can't wait.

this was by far the worst experience i have ever had across any service industry. the owner was beyond rude & the staff was careless & childish. the colorist slopped dye all over my face & neck, and when i blatantly asked if it would stain she said no & let it sit for over 30 minutes, after which i looked like i had a skin disease from all the dye. first peroxide was used to try to remove it, burning my face & neck, and then she tried windex on a cotton ball. when it wouldnt come off, she gave me the dirty cotton & said to try myself. when i told the owner how unhappy i was with the unprofessional service, he rudely asked me to leave instead of making it right. i walked out crying & hiding my face. forgot to mention the haircut was horrible as well, two snips with a blowdry. if u were considering this salon, id suggest buying a box color at CvS & getting supercuts instead because it would definitely be more worth your money & better executed.

So I order a lobster fried rice right thinking it was actual lobsters! Nope!!! Once I tried "lobster" it turned out to be crawfish!!! The managers had the never to tell me that it's lobster imitation!!! Did y'all know there was suck a thing???? I couldn't even finished it because it stinks and it tastes like it was frozen then cooked!! I even had their dumplings n their fried dumplings taste just like their steam dumplings!!! This is one of the worst experiences I've had!!! Since they don't know the difference between crawfish or lobster I added a picture of the differences!!!

My favorite pizza in Tucson.  The best kept secret in town is their happy hour with reduced prices on slices and Wine.  Did I mention their wine selection is great?  Wonderful crust, great cheese, Sauce and toppings.  Their salad is fantastic too.  Never miss the opportunity to stop by this place when I'm on that part of town!

Immediately seated and given water, the espresso was quick and tasty. After that it went downhill FAST. 
Stuck waiting 30+ minutes for the food and there were only 3 other customers at the time. The food was BAD. I ordered waffles w sausage gravy add 1 fried egg and a side of bacon. Bacon overcooked and crumbled when bitten. The egg was black on bottom like from a dirty griddle, sausage was PINK dangerously undercooked. I took 2 bites of waffle, that tasted good n nice texture but I was terrified because it was smothered in gravy containing raw pork. So I paid and left still hungry

My parents are Dominican and this place as authentic Dominican food! I had a craving for Sancocho and it was amazing! The penir was the best I have had in a while! The music brought me back to Dominican Republic!
Clean restaurant, cool set up, great staff! Delicious NY style pizza right here in Tucson, amazing! Try it out, you will be back again and again

The pizza was great but the games were better. The best employ was Gabriel who was a big help. A couple of the machines were broken and I told him and automatically he fixed them and reimbursed my lost tokens.
No pineapple.  Pizza served Luke warm.  Comes with bald spots where there is no cheese, even if you order extra cheese.  Expensive.

Now the reason I've given this place 5 stars....is only because Yelp  doesn't offer 100 star rating.  This pizza isn't the best in Tucson, it's not the best I've had in Arizona....not the finest pie I've had in California, Nevada, Washington, Colorado, Texas, New Mexico, Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Tennessee or anywhere I've been. It's easily the best  I've had in my life. ANYWHERE lNow granted.  I've not been to New York or Chicago.  I've heard amazing things about  Connecticut being the actual pizza capital of the world. But I'm a southern boy.   And I've been all across the south and had some ridiculous food.  BUT pizza is not a southern thing.  However, this pizza is just out of this world.  If the pizza is any better than thIs in NY..I don't know if I could handle it. Their salads are the best  I've ever tasted in my 46 years of living.  I just don't know if there are any better restaurants in this town.  Certainly not better  pizza spots.  
I'd go here  every single day if my wife would have it.

We used to love this place for so many reasons. Unfortunately Valley Green Inn has been very disappointing and I doubt coming back.  
I wonder if part of the problem has been that they were also hosting a wedding, but our food was late and cold :(. Especially 3 of 6 dishes.

If I could give a star less then 1 I would. I went there on a Tuesday with a group of friends (all bartenders) it seemed like the girl was training and we were understanding. A male bartender with a scar on his face that was with her was horrible. He openly ignored us. My friend asked for a drink she was ignored. She saw the manager and asked was there a problem and could he make her drink that she tried to order 10 mins ago and he blew her off as well. HORRIBLE HORRIBLE HORRIBLE.

Amelia is magical with color! Returned my hair color back to a beautiful auburn. She's vibrant, personable and professional. I always enjoy my visits at AMS and always feel comfortable there. They are a dynamic team!

I love pizza. First visit and I loved the flavors and texture of their pepperoni pizza. The only thing that eased my pain of the 16 inch Pizza for $20 was knowing that they probably used good ingredients. I would go here again! I like their infused olive oil and Parmesan. It's a cute place ; we went for a casual date night and enjoyed it.
So good and the pies always come out fast. The owner is super friendly and nice to chat with. I wish they would move to a larger location with more seating and a restroom.

The food was okay and the employees were nice enough.  The one star review comes from my conversation with the owner.  She was horribly rude to me and inspired me to never come back to the restaurant.  She made comments that made me horribly uncomfortable

This review is based on two visits. The overall idea is that the food is great. I've tried the Truffle egg toast twice and I love it. I wish it was a bit less oily but it does taste great. Their espresso is awesome considering how hard it is to get a nice cup of macchiato in Philly. Customer service could be a bit better hence the 4 star review. However this place is pretty cool and will definitely go back!
Wow, the quality of food has dropped. When they first opened I would always order from them. Now I don't know who is running the place anymore but it's just really bad!!!!

Come on. One of the best pizza places in town.

Friendly Atmosphere. Clean aesthetic. Simple menu.

They may only do a couple things and they do them well.

Never had had a bad experience here.

Support and thanks for the excellent experience.

Best pizza ever 

Their crust is amazing .. highly recommended 

Must try it's the best

I'm so fortunate to live down the block from this restaurant! This is one of my go to spots for breakfast, or whenever I need a place to just work on my weddings and grab a cup of coffee! I love their truffle egg toast- taste so luxurious. Also, love getting their 2 eggs with home-fries and meat. My Mom loves the scrambled w spinach, tomatoes and onions. There's a new Server Lady that's new to me who served us this past Wednesday and she was super pleasant. That's one thing that had gotten better through the past year is heir service. I moved to the area a year ago exactly and I brought my family here and was not pleased with the service. We felt like we were a bother eating there, but it's a complete 180 now- the service has changed for the better!

8.25 for a slice and a salad is a deal when the salad is overflowing from the plate. The salad was delicious however the lettuce isnt cut so make sure you have a knife ready. I ordered the margherita pizza the crust had just the right chewiness and char.

I took my daughter here for lunch because I had heard that it was a really nice peter piper. I was so excited to go. When we got there, it was packed with rude teenagers. It was kind of expensive for two lunch specials, when I should have just bought a pizza. I got in line for the "buffet" and by the time we got to the pizza it was cold, and dreary. Now I grew up with a peter piper down the street and have always loved their pizza, however this was awful. I couldn't even eat it. It tasted like cardboard that had sat out for hours. I would much rather go to cicis or chucke cheese. Not going back, not just the food, but the rude kids that trample my 2 year old.

When I set out to review this new(er) Peter Piper, what immediately came to mind was that scene in Oceans 11, where Danny and Rusty went to go ask Reuben for money... 

If you're gonna go to this Peter Piper, you'd better (er, gosh darn?) KNOW. This sorta thing used to be civilized, you'd play a few games, get a few tickets, eat some pizza, done. But with this location... at the end of this, you're gonna get trampled. You're going to have a hard time finding a place to sit. You're going to have to say "excuse me" a million times as you attempt to not step on other people's children while you chase after yours.

You should know what you're getting yourself into. Especially if you're going on a weekend, especially especially on a weekend evening. 

It's HUGE, probably part of the draw from all over town. There's a full sized carousel and one of those rides where you go in a circle in a wave (Himalaya something?). Both are free, and are great (well I can only comment on the carousel, my kid is too young for the other one).

Food is cheap, and it tastes better than it needs to for that price. Beer--$12 for a pitcher, HOLLA. And trust me, you're going to need a few pitchers to handle the chaos.

Peter Piper is doing everything right as far as price point, games, size. The lower rank (perhaps unfairly, although I do think there is more than can be done to do crowd and chaos control), is for atmosphere--especially during these busy times. It's almost like they need to employ hall monitors ("no running!" "no trampling!" "he had that game first!") for all the unruly children that are left unsupervised by the parents enjoying the $12 pitchers.

This is a great place to go if you'd like to let your kid run and play, and he's comfortable wearing a helmet and knee pads in public. Otherwise, may I suggest a Tuesday night... or even better, the PP on Soldiers Trail. It's about 1/4th of the size, has no where NEAR the number of games (and no slides/playground area, like the Broadway one... so if that's important to you, something to consider), but it's also significantly less busy. Definitely a cost-benefit analysis!

Fresh!  Nice dough. Suppose to be cold fermented for 72 hours. Nice flavor!  

Many choices of toppings. Home made sausages and cheese. From fennel Italian, lamb, etc etc etc. we got a slice and a small pizza. Ate in a nice clean establishment. A selection of beer and wine as well as a few sodas and water. 

Nice fresh authentic flavor!  You could taste the home made tomato sauces richness.
Super friendly staff!!! Oh, and booze... lots of booze!!!

I love this place. I started coming years ago as a meat eater and the ribs are to die for. Although I don't eat meat now i still bring friends here. I order sides. Across the board the food is great. I love the updates over the years and I enjoy the environment.

I come here several times a week for random stuff, instead of going to the grocery store or gas station for snacks. I've been noticing they close whenever they want. They do not stick to their hours of operation and they will lock the entrance door early so that you have to stand outside and use their walk up window which I find irritating that I called and a lady answered and I asked her what time do you keep the entrance door to the inside open till, she told me 8 pm. I get there at 7:45pm and they had already locked the door not even 10 minutes after I had called and she told me it would be open till 8. I asked why they locked the door already and she told me because they were "cleaning". If I'm able to go into a store and look around I'm more likely to make impulse buys and buy more items which is better for your business because a customer will spend more rather than having to go up to a window and ask for specific things. Just saying....And then again I called  at 8:40pm and asked the same lady what time they will be closing tonight and she told me to hold on, I heard her ask her coworker what time will they be closing tonight and he said 9pm. ( the posted hours for today a Monday is open till 10pm) I got there at 8:54pm and they were locking the windows and turned off the lights getting into their car. Yeah it's only 6 minutes early but I was right there ready to spend $20+ imagine if they do that everyday. If y'all say your open till 9pm then stay open to 9pm!!!or hire people that will actually work your posted hours of operation. Jeeze!!Just because they wanna go home early your business is losing profits. So please fix your hours of operation and update them to the actual hours you guys are open till because there is nothing worse than looking up a business or even calling them asking when their open till just to get there and it be closed already. I'll fix my review when y'all fix your hours.

We came here sort of by chance.  We needed to get groceries from TJ's and then my boyfriend's kids were hungry.  Being that they are picky eaters, pizza is usually a solid win with them.  So in we went.

We each got a slice (the kids kept it simple with cheese/pepperoni).  I went for a more gourmet option that was vegetarian, and my boyfriend got a slice with meat.

Sadly, the pickiness of the children kicked in and they rejected it (probably because it tasted so different than Domino's, and in a good way).  But hey, I wasn't sad to have more pizza to pick at.

The ingredients were some of the freshest I have ever had on a pizza.  Clearly they don't just get shredded cheese and put it on canned sauce and call it a day.  You can see the fresh non-preserved ingredients they put on their pizzas, from the cheeses, to the veggies.  And don't even get me started on how flavorful the sauce was.  It was some of the best I have ever had.  I can't even think of a better flavor on pizza sauce I've ever tested.

Long story short:  if you like something better than Domino's/Papa John's or other chain restaurants, and you like gourmet, fresh options, go here!  However, if you're looking for bland/boring pizza like Pizza Hut or your family/friends are picky and only like bland/boring pizza, this is not the place for you, but you'll seriously be missing out.

I had the worst customer service experience of my whole life there this past Thursday. It was so bad I am actually taking the time to write a review.

I went there with a group of African American guys and the waitress literally ignored us. We tried to get her attention and she just did say anything to us. One of our white friends came and then she finally came to take our orders. When it came time to pay I purposely used my credit card and stated outloud I wanted to pay so that she would not get a tip. At this point she finally tries to make an excuse that she was busy and didn't mean to ignore, which doesn't make any sense because she could have easily said "hey guys I will be right there" and she also served another table that was seated after us.

The bartender was almost just as bad, but at least took our drink orders when we realized the first waitress was ignoring us.

OMG PLEASE DONT EAT HERE!! 

I'm from Chicago where pizza is amazing , I've even lived in LA where it's not so great but nothing can compare to how bad this pizza is. They 100% used faked cheese! It's not real!! 

It will not melt. I've even tried putting it in the oven it remains shredded I am so extremely upset about this it is not OK to sell products with synthetic food! 

I have pictures I'll post to show. I'm sorry to slam them with this bad review but this is unethical.
Fresh delicious veggie burger on fabulous multi grain bread. Coffee was excellent. With party of six. Great service and relaxing atmosphere.

I didn't expect the sushi here to be great, but it was surprisingly good! I ordered the spicy tuna and the asian fusion roll. Asian fusion was really good! I would definitely go back. It's a lot easier than going into CC for sushi. Only issue was I had to wait about 35 minutes for take out.
Hands down the best pizza in Tucson. The. Crust is light and airy. The sauce perfect amount of tang. The only down part is it's closed on Sunday
I just ordered sausage and egg on bagel without cheese.  Guess what they added cheese!  I had my mouth ready for that sandwich this morning.  Oh well I'll just eat the home fries!

If it ain't broke, don't fix the darn thang.  Noooooooooooo!  Say it isn't so.  This place used to be a solid 4.5-5 stars when the old owner, B, was here.  I remember the place when it was a hole in the wall next to Wake Up Yoga when she first started out.  It was delicious from the beginning, and even when she expanded, she kept pace with the neighborhood while still keeping (and even improving !) the quality of the food.  

For years, this was my go-to haunt--beautiful, sweet homey decor--beautiful window to sit in and people watch, the amazing dulce de leche latte with homemade caramel sauce.

And the BEST pork sausage from a local farm. They changed it.  They changed that beautiful, juicy, thick, succulent little piggies that I used to squish into with my teeth and juice would roll down my chin.  To the worst kind of link sausage that tastes rubbery and it's like from the acme.  Not that there is anything wrong with the Ac-A-me, mind you.  I just don't like bob evans --and if I'm paying for cafe prices, I want cafe quality.  The eggs, instead of being fluffy and scrambled, are no folded into flat little dry squares.  I'll cop to the bread still being delicious, but that's about it.

Ashley and the rest of staff--have always been amazing and hospitable and sweet (and nicer than the rest of the servers and baristas in most hipster spots in the neighborhood)

Now I hear that all my favorite servers are leaving (hmmmmm, interesting--never a good sign)
The inside decor is going to be redone.  Yuck.  It's gorgeous in here.

I'll give it another chance in a couple of months, but if they change the beloved edison bulb installation in the center of the room, I'm am peace out, ya'll.

In So. Phil, people like what they like.

This place is beloved in the nabe'

People here don't love change.

I realize a new owner has to make it their own, but if it becomes a different place entirely, I don't predict it will survive.

Sad, but true, as the new owner seems like a nice guy.

All I can say is don't change one more thing.  Add, but don't take away.  

And bring back anything on the menu you changed.

And, lastly.....

Vive  LA SAUSAGE!!!!

Upon entering AMS, or should I say the lord of the rings-esque flight of stairs that are required to reach to the salon, I was told I need to continue the climb in order to get a cut.  The pain did not stop there as a simple cut ended up costing $90 which, compared to the quality, was a far cry from any corner salon in Philly.  Impersonal staff compound the problem, and, needless to say, I will not be visiting again.

What can I say, not my choice of pizza parlors but my my 7 ur old twin nieces decided this is where they wanted to have their birthday party.  Can't let them down.  The pizza is ok, nothing to write home about but not so bad that I wouldn't have any. They no longer sell pitchers of soda, all drinks are a la carte at $2.50 per small cup. You get "free" refills but at that price I really don't consider the refills as free.  The noise level is great if you're 7 yrs old! Then there are the games, rides and prizes. $100 later my nieces "won" some prizes and get to stand in line and pick out 25 small junk toys one at a time; of course that's after the 30 kids get to pick theirs first.  But most importantly my nieces are having a great time while Peter Piper cashes in on their happiness. So I guess it's worth it.

Such assholes.   My 18 year old  took him for nail trimming.  Wanted to fill the nexgat flea and tick for my dogs.  They wouldn't fill it because my 18 year old is behind 1 month for annual.  18 years old. The one doctor told me last year to let him just enjoy the rest of his life.  These fools want me to put him through shots to rack up money I guess!  Bye bye Girard  finding another vet!   

Btw took my English bulldog there three times in the last 3 months spent close to 1000 dollars and they did NOTHING for her.  She now goes to UPENN!    Frustrated as all hell!!!

The "Fig, Pig and Goat" is moving up my list of favorite specialty pies of Tucson. A near masterpiece!  This is a cool joint and not the pretentious kind of cool. Bring an appetite with and try the cheese and meat board,  perfect. Bring a thurst and try PL's lemonade of the day, amazing!  These are really nice pizza people and are true pizza artisans.
Quesadillas are amazing! Chicken quesadilla was one of the best I've had! Alsl tried the wings.... not bad at all. Meaty. Drink was blah....would definitely return for food.

It's a dive bar so....You get what you pay for. The Happy Hour is good, $2.75 for domestic beers $3.95 for all others on tap. Wings are good and only $0.35 on Tuesday's. But it's nothing to write home about. The bartenders aren't attentive, in fact the one that was there tonight walked past my check with cash sitting on top of it waiting to be paid at least 5 times before my friend somehow got her attention and asked for our change. It's not bothersome if you plan on spending a long time chilling at the bar, but certainly not A+ service.

Ordered takeout from here and got the Bianca with regular crust and one with cauliflower crust. Sometimes with cauliflower crust it's not always crispy and this one was really good. The Bianca was a nice light summer pizza. The caprese was also delicious and refreshing. Takeout took 15 minutes and they even have a takeout parking spot.

I don't have the doctors name. She had short hair and was terrible with my dog. I won't deny he's difficult, but the way she handled him was horrific. Her first solution within minutes was to sedate him, which really isn't the safest. I came a week prior with the same issue and when I was still concerned about his situation I came back for a further check up. She was far more patient the first time but this visit she gave up without trying. Is this not their job? She denied service for the same issue and refused to let me talk to another dr, including the one that assisted last time. He's a puppy and was nervous and she amped him up ten fold. Horrible service and extremely unprofessional.

It is illegal in nearly every state except for PA for a vet to not release a prescription for cat food. But this practice refuses to do so, even after weeks of requests. FOR CAT FOOD! It may be legal, but we will see if they will like a complaint filed with the AVMA. Clearly, I will not return to this practice ever again.
Super friendly staff! Good for work: wifi, plugs, ambiance. Good coffee :)
This place is always good, always fast. Always friendly. Their menu is diverse and nothing has failed me yet. 10/10 bravo

Ok, I'm going to have to disagree with the review by RG below. We had an excellent waiter today-  he was on time with water, coffee and food service. He was pleasant without being in your face- which is just you want in a Sunday morning waiter

Food was pitch perfect - I was pleased with my Berry French Toast Waffle and she her Grilled fig/peach salad.

Plates are appetizer sized, but the portions do fill the plates. 

My mexican coffee (from a french press) was .... just... wow.

anyhow- feel free to go JUST for the coffee.

Only drawback-
Chhaya is somewhat small and rather warm in summer (of course this is a scorcher weekend).

We will happily go back in future to sample those great tastes again.
Excellent chicken shawarma sandwich! Best I've had in Tampa! For $5.5 the shawarma pita is filling and great! I will be back!

I could not recommend this place enough. I took my rabbit to see Dr. Balzer to get spayed. The consultation was very informative and the surgery went very well. I was also given a lot of information on aftercare and how to administer medications. The price was much much more reasonable than other vets in the area. I will definitely be back!

Stopped by and ordered a Traditional Pepperoni pizza, it was delicious! The pizza is made to order,  right in front of you with fresh ingredients. They make their own dough in house as well as their sauce and sausage. Customer service is also really good! Best pizza I have had in a while, can't wait to come back for more! If I could give it 10 stars I would!

Very delicious dinner and dessert.

Roasted salmon: perfectly cooked with flavorful corn and succotash. Highly recommend 

Banana bread pudding: comes with vanilla ice cream. You can taste the banana, the bread is moist with perfect sweetness 

Chocolate mousse: rich chocolate without being overly sweet 

Overall it's a great dining experience with beautiful surroundings
great tacos but the real hero is the gordita.  also be careful, when they say spicy they are not screwing around, there is some serious heat they put in these dishes.

I give Pizza Luna a four star because the pizza is amazing. The wine selection is great as well. I've been here for lunch and dinner. The staff is wonderful. The place is a tad small but gives you that Bug city pizza place feel. The pizza Bianca is my favorite. The cheese board is so flavorful as well. Please try them out. Located right next to Trader Joe's

I love this place for many reasons. One being they allow you to bring your pets in. Today I went in for brunch and unfortunately waited too long to get asked for a drink order, so I had to go up and order myself. I understood, they were busy, but I still felt a little ignored. After finally placing my food order, the wait to get it wasn't too bad and the service was sufficient. I paid for my meal, but noticed my drink was not included. When I asked, the waitress said "I know, but I felt bad because you waited so long." So yes, I may have waited a bit too long to get initial service, but the staff is overall great and understanding. I didn't ask for anything extra or to be given free and still gave a 20% tip because sometimes accidents just happen.

The food here is pretty average, very interesting when you read the menu but everything is pretty basic but over priced. Coffee isn't great. Also expensive. The service is also not great but not bad either. This place is good in a pinch if you want breakfast in the area. The hours suck. If you want pancakes at 6am anywhere near passyunk ave you're screwed.

went for Thanksgiving based on an article somewhere I had found which called it one of the top Thansgiving spots in Philly, as well as the most romantic.  

The drive through the beautiful trees sets a relaxed tone very well.  Very cute, small place.  Really pulls you out of the grip of the city and transports you to another place, I felt like I was in Vermont.  

Their Thanksgiving food was what you'd expect to be at Thanksgiving dinner.  Nothing over the top or super special.  But at $37 a head this was an amazing value for a very nice and quaint Thanksgiving dinner.
Good food. All right service. A rude short guy works there. Great pizza and cesar radicchio although I would say Time Market has better pizza.

I am reviewing the games, not the food. (We usually go here after dinner). This place is so much fun! I am usually the disciplinarian at home, so it delights my girls that I can laugh and play like they do. We have found that it's best to go later, it's much less crowded. One day, we'll try the pizza and I'll have a new review to write!

Don't do it. Dr. Balzer is a very condescending woman who is not genuine. I brought my pup here and they diagnosed him with lymes disease. They gave me antibiotics and sent me on my way. They were very short and made it my job at finding answers rather than giving me them. I was told my dog would be a new dog by the next day. 4 days later he was worse than before and out of pain medication. They had no interest in giving him more or seeing what was wrong, and my poor pup couldn't even get out of bed without shrieking in pain. I brought my dog to my normal vet and they were very understanding and had him feeling better in no time. I didn't even go into how horrible their message girl is at taking messages and relaying them.  If you love your pet, find somewhere else... seriously.

What a delicious surprise! Mark, the owner has several restaurants in Portland and serves up some of the best pizzas we've had anywhere! Salads are generous and seasoned just right. Highly recommend you try this little gem located in the corner of the strip mall by Trader Joe's on Speedway.

My boyfriend and I came to clearwater to vacay and visited this place, we just wanted a Dominican meal and a delicious Dominican drink and we got just as we asked... excellent customer service, price is just right, food portions was generous and the drinks were amazing, also bought a pineapple cake and omg soooo delicious!! Will definitely visit before I head back to NY.

I did find this place on yelp! Great find!
Excellent pizza. sauce and ingredients so fresh. Loved our pizza and salad . Service was great. Charming little establishment.

Have been here twice now, both times great!  The Luna Board is beautiful and tasty, as are the Margherita and the Sausage Bianca pizzas.  We chose two of the house pizzas but there was a surprising number of gourmet toppings available, including pancetta, goat cheese, fior di latte.  Everything we have had has been made with fresh, quality ingredients.  Crust is a great mix of crispy and chewy.  Great service - it started raining heavily while we were there, and someone offered to walk us out to our car with an umbrella which was kind.  Great choice for a more casual Neopolitan-style pizza fix with foodie toppings.

Very helpful and friendly staff who are happy to take my beginner questions, and also offered tea while my friend and I started our new projects in their living room area. They sold everything we needed to get started, and took me on a tour of options when I requested recommendations for "glittery" floss. The only thing that could be improved would be having a bar, but you can't have everything.

I visited this office 10 years ago. Underneath my car I found a beautiful long haired male cat. First I sat in the waiting area for 65 minutes because it was walk in only. The receptionist became snotty when I asked I should return another day.

The vet was friendly and asked if I wanted the new cat's teeth cleaned. I agreed...the next day   someone left a snotty message that the cat has FIV so it was put to sleep. Really? You never even asked me! Cats can live with this disease. When I phoned back to explain that this was a street cat a Hispanic vet tech started raising his voice at me. I paid $300 for a cat that I didn't get to keep. He was an incredible sweetheart!

Later on as I described this to a friend who owned a collection agency, he stated, "Oh, that is the vet who never pays the man who balances the scales. When I phoned there asking to send payment they slammed the phone down on me.

Order from this spot a couple times a week. They have my favorite crispy noodles for the soup,home made not the tiny dry noodle strip.Bbq ribs and fried wings are solid.  Enjoyed the pork dumplings and dinner specials.

Came here to pick up coffee and bagel sandwiches to start the day. They messed up the bagel orders. Please check your orders before leaving. Also, the bagels are very tough. Coffee was good, hence the 2 stars.

Can I just say I feel lucky to have this place in my hood?

I can't count the number of times that I have needed some dumb, random item while I was cooking and it is so nice to be able to walk around the corner and grab it versus hopping in the car and driving to Safeway or Food City.

They have an amazing selection of booze as well.  Everything from low end wine and beer, to top shelf liquor and nice wines.  It's a little more expensive than buying at a chain, but well worth it to support a local business.

And finally the staff.  They are like neighbors, they are super friendly and once they know you they will always take good care of you.

This place is one of the things that makes living downtown great!

I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone! I brought my 13y old Chow mix into this CLINIC to get blood work. She has hypothyroidism & I needed a new SCRIPT because they only last 1 year. PennVet did her blood work in 2016 and charged $400 and issued her 25 scripts but it was time for blood work. I went to Girard Clinic for a new blood work and for a new script. When I checked out my bill was $361 for blood work! I thought wow this is almost as high as PennVet but only a CLINIC so why? My dog had only been off her meds for 3days on Nov. 30. On Dec 1st they claimed that her blood work showed no sign of a problem. In possibly! She was diagnosed in 2011 and has been on meds since. I tried contacting many times but NEVER got a call back! Only emails! I called them many times but got the same response from the receptionist and NEVER a call! By the 15th of December nothing yet! My FURBABY was getting worse by the day and I conveyed that to them all day on the 15th but by 5p I haven't heard back and my baby was getting worse. I went around there and the office was closed! Wow! I contacted PennVet to see if they could help. Paws Philadalphia allowed me to come in because I sure didn't have another $400 right then. Paws Philadalphia looked at her medical record, drew her blood and put her back on her meds. Off her meds for 20 days at this point and not doing well at all! I emailed Girard a piece of my mind. That Monday the 18th Girard was still claiming my dog does not have a thyroid problem! PennVet Dr. Cai spoke with Girard and told them they are wrong. Still no script  from Girard but Dr. Cai at Penn had my back and put a script in for me. She already was starting to get better. By Wednesday the 20th Girard was trying to act like they were doing something and still doing nothing! If I was waiting of Girard my baby would of GOD FOR BID been not here!! I will be taking them to court for my $400 because they absolutely did nothing! They have nothing Humane about them and they could of cared less if my dog would have died! They never once picked up the phone and called me to say anything! Who gives results from blood work and don't call the person to explain them! They are an over priced CLINIC that is only in it for money! Any occupancy that requires caring for another have to have compassion for what they do. They have prices like PENNVET but don't supply nothing for what they charge!! Going back to PENNVET at least there you feel the love and know your dog is in good hands! Girard needs to close their doors!

I ordered pizza online over an hour ago and it still isn't here, which usually is understandable but I called multiple times to check on the order and nobody answered any of the times and now the restaurant is closed. No notification of cancellation or anything.
Great staff and beautiful location! Perfect place to grab some apps and a beer after a hike or to host a private event. Wish they had more vegan options but other than that no complaints.

Very nice place for brunch. We walked in hoping we wouldn't have to wait too long. We were told 15-20 minutes, but were seated in 5 minutes! Once we sat the server came over, introduced himself and poured or water. The water had a bad smell to it, guess I'm not used to tap water anymore lol. I ordered regular coffee and it was very good, although I'll probably try one of the many other coffee options next time. I ordered the cornbread waffles with sausage gravy, added an egg, a side of home fries and a side of the thick cut bacon. Yes, it was all delicious! The waffles were exactly what I thought they would be as far as flavor goes, the home fries were fresh off the fryer, crispy and hot. The bacon, well... it's thick cut bacon, you can't go wrong with thick cut bacon lol. The service was also great. It was a little different, as we were serviced by multiple people at all times, but it worked very well. I like to call it great team work! Needless to say, I'll be back!
Best pizza I have ever eaten! We have eaten here three days in a row because we were so impressed with taste and quality of the food. I highly recommend this spot for a slice or even a whole pie.

We were pleasantly surprised in how good their pizza was. We ordered the pepperoni on a cauliflower crust. It was very tasty, great sauce, and the crust was awesome. The only draw back, we should have ordered 2.

***Zero Stars***** This company is horrible, incompetent and do not give a **** about the homeowner. They just take your money month after month, and when you have a valid complaint, they claim there is nothing they can do about it. I made a very legitimate complaint (I will not go into detail because I am now forced to take legal action), but let's just say that this company completely disregarded my issue, even when I had months of proof to back up my complaint. They claimed that there is absolutely nothing they could do and tried to palm me off on another outside agency. So I asked if paying them was now an option for me since they choose when they can and cannot do their job, they ignored me. I only bought my home barely a year ago and am already considering moving because I refuse to pay an HOA anything when they don't give a **** about the homeowners concerns. They dirtbags and money hungry.
My new go to pizza place. I have 12-15 places for pizza that are closer but I drive the extra distance and time for Great Pizza. Thanks!!

Terrible. Ordered late-night delivery to our hotel- pizza with mushrooms and olives, salad for me, hot wings for boyfriend. You would think they'd throw in plastic utensils, seeing as we ordered to a hotel, but no. It was okay though... Apparently you have to specifically tell them you want salad dressing when you order a salad or it comes without it. Tomatoes were mushy. Boyfriends wings were a weird pink color with barely any sauce and what sauce was there was not good. And New York style pizza my butt. Coming from NJ, I don't appreciate how good our pizza is until we are outside of the NY/NJ area. This pizza was awful. Nevermind that the mushrooms smelled funky and overpowered the pizza. The sauce was totally tasteless. Seriously my boyfriend and I actually used his blue cheese dressing from the wings ON THE PIZZA just to make it taste better, and I don't even like blue cheese. If we hadn't been starving we would have just thrown it out. At least the delivery guy was nice.

Amazing! Definitely my favorite pizza spot in Tucson. I always get a large traditional with pepperoni, mushrooms, roasted garlic, baby kale, spicy sausage. Light cheese. Flippin amazing!
The employees are cool.

The sitting area is quite limited but who cares (I don't!)...it adds to the atmosphere.

Salads are great as well.
Had yet to find a faviorite pizza spot near my house. Can't say that anymore! Super delicious. Crust is great. Sauce is great. Will definitely order again :)

My poor dog has been sick for a month with a treatable illness (thyroid).  I've been begging them to treat her.

They keep running expensive tests, but never call me back with the results.  I've physically gone into the office and begged them to help her.  I keep getting "the doctor will call you".  It never happens.

My dog has gotten worse and worse.  She has become incontinent.   I have to buy a new couch and bed.  The poor girl was on her side in a puddle of urine when I got home today.

She is suffering horribly, for no reason other than a true lack of professionalism and caring.  No excuse!

I'll be going to the office yet again, asking for her records (including the latest round of expensive tests that the doctor won't talk to me about).  

I have to take her to an emergency clinic tomorrow, she is so miserable and is suffering so much.

There is no excuse for this level of animal cruelty.  It's gone beyond lack of caring. 

Beware!  They take your money, then don't treat your poor dog.  Run away!  Go ANYWHERE else!
5star pizza !! No lie it's really delicious . Love their marinara sauce. Will be returning found my new pizza joint.

Liars Liars Liars. Metiras. Peor comida de Tampa. Worst Food EVER!!! Family members must be the ones repeatedly posting good reviews.  Ugly Dry Rice, Bones For meat as a serving Overcooked Yuka. sloppy bad service. Husband Nice Man Wife bulldog Nasty attitude. This is my third and the last visit. They say 3 times is a charm. Guess NOT!!! I only went there because they are in the same plaza as my nail salon.  Maybe to a Gringo that doesn't know any better as far as if its good or what to expact but not to us Latinos. I SHOULD OF ASKED FOR MY A REFUND Terrible Restaurant zero thumbs up.

BANANA BREAD PUDDING WAFFLES with PECANS STRAWBERRIES Bananas AND FRESH WHIP CREAM and chocolate drizzle. 

What is this sorcery and what does it mean for my waist line..?!?!! 

It's a seasonal special and it's a decadent, artfully crafted, masterpiece. Drools will follow, and dreams will be brought to life. Dessert for brunch?! I'll buy into this lifestyle. 

Next up the truffled toast with arugula, pesto, and runny egg on top. This was a hit and delicately flavored. 

However the banana bread pudding waffle I can not exclaim and rejoice of all the ways it made my heart sing! It spoke to me..

The fresh squeezed OJ is imported from Lancaster Dairy company and it was like sipping on some fine wine. 

The artsy, industrial chic vibes, provided a quaint and inviting atmosphere! 

BRUNCH is highly recommended here!!

Very poor service.  I accidently put in an identical double order.  The restaurant never called me to verify or check.  To make things worse I was double charged but only received one order.  Pizza is decent but not worth a double order.  Be careful.

We love going to Valley Green Inn, at any time of year.  Summer is great as you can sit outside.  Winter is cozy in the restaurant with the fire going in the fireplace.  The food is very good, and good selection.  The prices of wine by the glass are reasonable. The service is very good and servers very pleasant and nice!

I was thrilled to step into Rittenhouse Needlepoint and browse the seemingly endless selection of threads and needlepoint tools. The atmosphere of the retail space is so inspiring and they've done a great job with their new space. I work in the same building as the store and had been meaning to stop in for a long time, but unfortunately I'm unable to give this establishment a 5 star review. I went in with my sister to pick out threads for a new project, and as we we're wrapping up and getting ready to check out, the woman who I assume was a manager or owner began to reprimand her employee right next to us. So aggressively and obnoxiously that you could cut the tension in the air with a knife, we were the only four people in the space. That same employee she was yelling at was very kind and helpful to us beforehand as we browsed. My sister and I were so second handedly embarrassed. We completed our transaction and got out of there as soon as possible. That scolding could have waited another 3 minutes until after we were gone. It was so unprofessional and I'm no longer excited to return. an otherwise wonderful experience was unnecessarily turned sour. I hope the management reconsiders the treatment of their employees especially in front of paying costumers because the space and the products are great.

I can't get enough of their pizza.  The crust is best in town.  The traditional sauce has a tomato and garlic flavor.  The pepperonis are huge.  Currently, the cheese pizza and pepperoni pizza is half off if you order before 4:00 pm, so you can get a large pepperoni for a little more than $11.00.

I started coming here when I first began stitching, mostly because they were the only store within walking distance that offered a large stock of DMC and other floss to help me fill out my collection. This store has most everything you need in the way of floss and notions. Keep in mind I mostly cross stitch, and I find everything here that I need. 

I've taken one point off, however, because the mark-up is just too much for me to continue coming here. With tax, each skein of DMC thread is 92 cents (85 cents without). Ouch. Like really. Ouch. I have resorted to ordering my floss online because even with shipping it is less expensive. There ARE some options that are cheaper than ordering online, however, such as bobbins or needles. This is a nice place to go if you need to pick something up here or there. 

I've also taken a point off because of customer service. While the majority of my experiences at Needlepoint have been pleasant, these very pleasant experiences are mostly with the staff who are there. I happened to wander in on a day when their computer system was down. The owner was very upset--understandably so--but to the point where it got awkward and he was being rude to his staff in front of me. This was off-putting in a place where previously I loved the friendly atmosphere. I will continue frequenting Needlepoint, and will update this review should I feel the original luster of the store return.

Taken advantage of their 50 % off pepperoni/cheese pizza between 12 and 4 pm twice. That's an amazing deal for quality ingredients and good crust, can't ask for more. Will definitely try their other pizzas when I get the chance to eat out again.
This place is on point! Gluten free heaven since they make the corn tacos fresh and so soft.  We had the chicken, rib eye and my favorite the fish (not gluten free, but relish).

My favorite pizza place, hands down. Even a simple pepperoni pizza is great from here but another favorite is the fig, pig, and goat. Recently tried a new salad, they are simple but good salads. I only wish they had more menu options because it's all so good!

Excellent pizza! My wife and I love their pizza and unique salads. The salads are tasty and have very interesting ingredients. The staff is friendly and very helpful. They are our favorite pizza place in Tucson!
We recommend them strongly.

My oh my, the crust is outstanding! Chewy and salty, like fine bread you get from European bakeries. The toppings are high quality too and the pies are made with care. The garlic knots have chunks of fresh garlics and the house made sauce is tomato-y. This is a great place for high end pizzas.

I'd taken my cat here to get neutered before and it went off without a hitch. 

But earlier this week, I'd noticed that he was having difficulty urinating. He was straining, spending a good deal of time in his litter box, and passing very little fluid. I immediately took him to this animal hospital and explained the problem. They said they would hold on to him until at least the evening and to call that afternoon. 

When I called, I was told that he had started passing blood in his urine, and that they wanted to keep him overnight. 

The next day, they call me and tell me that he's taking in fluid and urinating without issue and that I can come take him home. When I come to pick him up, they give me some medication for his joints. I ask what it's for, and the vet tech says that he seems "a little sore." She then proceeds to explain that "Sometimes older cats have trouble with their joints." I told her that my cat is only three, to which she replies "Yeah." 

...Okay. So I take him home. He still has trouble urinating, but I figure that it will pass. 

The next day, I notice that he's severely lethargic and almost completely incapable of urinating. At this point, he's just lying in his litter box. I call the vet, and she asks if his bladder is distended. I feel around and say I'm not sure. She says that if his bladder is distended, I have to take him elsewhere because they are closing. 

At this point, I'm panicking. I ask if she knows what is/was wrong with him, and she says that they didn't think they needed to catheter him (even though I brought him in because he couldn't urinate) and that they couldn't get any urine to test (despite the fact that they had told me that he was urinating all day without issue and THAT IS WHY they let me take him home). 

It is at this point that I realize that I have to take him to an emergency vet. When I get him to UPenn, they immediately take him in and put a catheter in him because his bladder is very distended and his urinary tract is blocked. They wanted to run some tests and keep him for a couple of days... they also told me that it's good that I had brought him in, because he would have died without veterinary care. 

Now, I understand that with this sort of business, the reviews on Yelp are perhaps more likely to reflect whether or not the vet was able to help, regardless of whether the problem could have even been helped. 

HOWEVER, the veterinarian LIED to me. Whether it was when I was told that my cat was urinating without problem and that I could take him home or if it was when I was told that there was no urine available to test, these people lied to me. I paid almost $200 for them to sell me medication my cat didn't need, to lie to me, and to endanger my cat's life... and that is simply unconscionable.

I was pleasantly surprised at how good this place was. Pizza is pizza, right? Wrong. Maybe I'm a pizza snob, I don't know, but I'm picky with my pizza. Theirs is a delicious thin crust - not too thin, but with a good char on the bottom. This may be one of my new go-tos when I get a craving for a slice or a pie

We picked this place because the menu was slipped under our hotel door and we were starving. So glad we did, they took great care by calling to confirm our complicated order, (wife can't do dairy and we split the pizza with only half with cheese and a ton of other requests) they were courteous and food arrived hot and quick. Fried mushrooms were really great and big hit with the kids (2 and 8). They do not skimp on cheese, someone had the chicken parmigiana and when I handed it to her I could not see past the cheese. I had a chicken gyro and it was excellent, grilled chicken, fresh lettuce and chopped onions, I did ask them to hold off the tomatoes. Would order again for take out

I was only here for a quick stop on a Saturday afternoon in September. I had a delicious coffee and an everything bagel while waiting for my massage appointment around the corner. A super cute place, good looking brunch menu - looks great! I will definitely be back next time I'm on Passyunk.

YUM! After a long day of gem hunting, Pizza Luna hit the spot!  Crust was oh so soft but crunchy, but the fried basil is what put it over that top! Would definitely return for more.
FYI: A small would likely be plenty for two to share.

I was surprised to see such a cute building in the middle of a park.  The park is beautiful.  I decided to have lunch here.  I had the Black Angus Burger which was an Eight-ounce burger with Sharp Cheddar, Lettuce, Tomato, Onion, Pickle, and VGI sauce.  It was served with a side salad.  The burger was great.  They had a nice selection of beers.  The service was great and the prices were right.

Tried the fig goat and pig pizza. Was supposed to have garlic but didn't taste any till my 3rd  piece. Fig flavor was faint as  well with what I think was some added fig sauce drizzle. Nice chunks of lardon and pizza was cooked well.  No tangy goat cheese flavor either. Just didn't find enough contrast of flavors with this pizza so will probably go back to the standard with their good sausage. Great simple salad with fresh greens and mild radicchio, and well made homemade tarragon dressing. The guys are busy but always friendly and accommodating. Good local hand-made pizza, our go-to.

Damn fine pizza, good wine selections, and don't deny yourself the experience of the radicchio Caesar salad, which is the most intense dressing I've had outside my house.  Great stuff, fast, and friendly guys.  Good little patio out front to eat during Covidpalooza too.

Been there 2 times already. We had the Little Gems salad. The green goddess dressing was great! 
We ordered the house favorite Margarita, pepperoni, Puttanesca, and the Sausage Rossa. The large pizza are big, plenty for a group. The crust was soft and chewy and they had plenty of toppings. Drinks were in bottles and there is a self serve water. Service was attentive and it was fun to watch them make our pizzas in front of us. The restaurant is small so go early.  They also have patio seating. So convenient to Trader Joe's and Starbucks.

Delicious! Came here on a Sunday for brunch and the wait was about 15-20 min. They have tasty offerings for brunch, such as quiche and chicken and waffles, but I opted for an omelet and home fries. The omelet was good, I just wish it had larger chunks of sausage in it. The home fries were also great! 

Great place to meet a friend for a quick and delicious brunch. I'd come back if in the area.
An unassuming dive bar with friendly staff and decent food. Basic bar menu with great (dive bar) prices. A staple for young people.

I tell everyone I know to go to Girard! Everyone there is so thoughtful: vets, vet techs, receptionists. Our cat went through a really challenging cancer diagnosis that she unfortunately did not survive. But in the three months we were treating her, we felt so supported and cared for by everyone at Girard. Dr. Wilkerson kept up regular communication with VSEC doctors, so we were able to avoid the higher priced option of taking her to the animal hospital for the most part. Special shout-out to receptionists Quiana and Leigha for their senses of humor and kindness, they really made the whole thing more bearable. 

This is an amazing clinic full of people who truly care about your pet.

Re opening day , quiet nice for me, grandsons 5th birthday lunch ( 3 adults one child " pandemic bdAy , plus zoom family gathering) . Only one other small family , just 4 of us., one other family came in sat 50!yards away! More employees than customers . I didn't eat , but big game room , all looked very clean . Bottom line I felt comfortable . 
Lunch pizza buffet 6.99/4.99$  plus regular menu . It's all about the fun ,food & activity . All employees in masks . Someone at door to do curbside takeouts . I'll give it 4 stars the 5 year old liked it! 

Manger and staff " ready to get the parties started" !

Update: Tonight was my dad's 91st birthday party. We had Pizza Luna make pizza for 40+ guests plus the Simple Greens salad. EVERYONE raved about the pizza - it's so good! I didn't think people would eat the salad because pizza, but they did! EVERYONE loved the salad. It could not have been any better. Gabe even loaned us a pizza carrier with racks inside which kept the pizzas warm and prevented the pizza cartons from getting squished. BTW, we had three vegans and Pizza Luna made us a pizza with vegan "cheese" that I provided, and even made a separate gluten free pizza for one of our guests. These guys are awesome. Thank you Gabe & Chris & Pizza Luna!


Three of us went to Pizza Luna this afternoon around 4:30 pm. We were greeted by a super friendly guy named Travis who explained the menu and told us that on Tuesday, and bottle of wine is 1/2 off. So we got a really great bottle of Pinot Noir from Oregon and then ordered our pizza. We got Sausage Rosso and plain cheese - both traditional, and a simple green salad with tomatoes added. James made the pizza - the crust is perfection.  Everything was delicious. Kyle was working behind the counter also - three friendly guys who seemed to like their jobs and their boss Caleb. We were so eager to dig into the pizza and salad that I forgot to take any photos until we were finished, so I took photos of the place. Notice how exceptionally shiny clean it is!  Thanks guys - now we have a new, great pizza place
Awesome secret spot. Fantastic lunch with the most whimsical view and weather. The service was top notch and the food Devine. Horses passing by to boot.

Look, you insufferable morons, this place is pretty damn good for what it is.  It's not a Michelin starred restaurant.  It's not the right place to propose to your fiancée.  It's not the spot to take drag your overseas friend to show off the ultimate in quintessential Philadelphia cuisine.

It's tasty.  The prices are low and reasonable.  There are a lot of TVs showing a lot of sports all the gosh-danged time.  It's a peachy place to post up and watch the first 89 rounds or so of the National Spelling Bee.

The food won't win any awards for creativity but who cares?  Get the Santa Fe Chicken on a roll instead of a bun and swap out the fries for a side of mixed vegetables.  This is the most valuable thing you've ever read on Yelp.  You're welcome.  And if you don't like it, then Hey, Fuck You

Meritus is responsible for our HOA maintenance in Hernando Oaks. They have contracted with Millenium Lawn Care to provide service.  I live in a villa home, so they are responsible for the outside, and it is horrible.  The lawn service allowed vines to grow through my shrubs and kill them.  Instead of replacing the plants, they pull them out and just leave huge bare beds.  They use weed killers to edge the lawn, kill the grass and weeds overgrow. Current my sod had a 12" dead ring around the perimeter due to this.  Claim they spray and feed the lawn, but I have never had a tag indicating this, and have large dead patches throughout my lawn.

The irony is that we have homes in the neighborhood that are not maintained by Meritus but they can cite them and demand that they perform maintenance.  Meritus holds these homeowners to a completely different standard than they hold for themselves.

I cannot see anything changing as long as they have the right to collect payment but are not obligated to perform the services for which they collect the HOA to the agreed upon standard.  It seems like a racket to me

I have contacted them so many times that I have lost count. They do not even return calls.

Found this place for a quick bite with my kid on a Trader Joe's run.
And now I have returned many times without bothering to stop in at Trader Joe's. 
Fast, friendly, efficient service.
Good beer and wine.
Top quality salads.
And then the pizza.  Love this style of pizza - probably my favorite.  Thin crust, quality ingredients, high heat. Of course, the crust will be charred in spots. That's the style.  If you are turned off by a little carbonized crust, then this may not be the pizza place for you. 
It is the place for me.  
Definitely a top 10 (top 5?) place for pizza in Tucson.

Rittenhouse Needlepoint (confusingly located on 11th and Arch) is an incredible needlepoint shop, with a few flaws. 

I've always had great experience with the staff, particularly the thin dark-haired woman who works on Saturdays (Sofia?). She's very friendly and remembered the project I had picked out several weeks prior. She's also spent time helping me kit various canvases. 

I will say that I think their finishing department is somewhat overpriced compared to what is available online these days. Of course quality is worth paying for, but if they charge $200 to finish a belt and people elsewhere charge $80, that's a tough sell for me. Worth shopping around before you commit to getting items finished there!

Their website is terrible- completely unusable by 2021 standards. They are -still- offering appointment-only shopping with very limited hours, and are not open on Sundays. This makes it very challenging for anyone with a job to patron their business. 

Finally, I think their canvas selection is subpar. They do not carry several popular and well-known needlepoint designers such as Alice and Blue and Bad B*tch Needlepoint. 

TLDR: large needlepoint Mecca with a friendly staff and extremely large fiber selection, but lackluster and relatively small canvas selection. I typically purchase canvases online and kit them at Rittenhouse Ndlpt.

The pizza was honestly great. Nice thin crust and no grease. However, it loses a star because the employees were not wearing face masks. In these hard times I'm trying to support local restaurants by ordering takeout occasionally, and it does make me feel more comfortable when the employees are wearing appropriate PPE. I would go back in the future, but not until everyone working is wearing a mask.

I'm such a jerk for never having written a review about this salon! I've had the pleasure of having my hair balayaged by Amelia who is the most amazing colorist. Seriously, book an appointment with her you won't regret it! Although I haven't seen her in a while since moving, I have to say I dream about her doing my hair all the time! After having her do my hair, no one else could even keep it up to par. I have never had such an amazing experience with someone doing my hair. The salon is super cute and clean. All the girls I met were really sweet. Now that I'm back in the area, I can't wait to make an appointment again!

The place was hopping with happy, full belly little kids running around playing games!  Stopped in for the lunchtime buffet and got our fill of pizza.  This is by far one of the coolest Peter Pipers I have seen in regards to the kid zone, they have a legit roller coaster inside!  The pizza was good but the buffet was overcrowded and difficult to navigate from pan to plate.  They just had to many options on line at once.

Most of my rating goes for the cute factor since it's uncontested that this spot is adorable and clean. There's a coffee bar and regular seating, and they have a pretty detailed brunch menu. I got the belgian waffle with berries while my boyfriend sprung for the huevos rancheros waffle, and I think mine was a lot better than his. My waffle was a classic buttermilk base, and I almost sprung for real maple syrup before I realized it kind of doesn't really matter. It's everything I expect out of a waffle, though giving 3 corners versus the whole thing feels a tad cheap. 

I don't think cornmeal does well in anything outside of really well-executed cornbread, so to turn this into a waffle fell way out of my expectations. It was dry, but luckily the toppings saved it for the most part.

That being said, I'd definitely come back to try some of the savory brunch dishes!

To start we have been sitting at the table for 10 minutes and have yet to see a server. I will update when we do. We have already picked out entrees. To bad we can't place the order. The room is dark. I get the vibe they, but i understand the vibe. Server was busy. Came over after 13 min. His name is joe. Nice guy so that redeems him some. Food came in a decent time. Nothing spectacular. I have the Mac n cheese. Friend had the shrimp. We have now been waiting for 15 min for boxes and a check while the server clearly eats in the kitchen. Don't think this will be on my list of must return to places. Band was ok. Quality of speakers wasn't great so a lot of rattling and vocals were drowned out by instruments.

Yes! A great pizza option in the midtown area. I will gladly pay a premium and pick up the pie myself if I know it's thoughtfully prepared and with high quality ingredients. I realize I'm being a bit of a tough customer here, and I'm breaking from the pack by rating Luna four stars (subject to change). It would make a huge difference if table service were offered, and I would be much more inclined to dine in rather than take out. There are only about ten small tables. Seems like one or two servers could handle this with no problems at all. The service without it seems a bit "pizza-parlorish" which doesn't seem to match the vibe that the rest of the restaurant is shooting for. The clean and modern space, the wine list, the pizza! It's asking for a more refined experience.

I was a bit nervous to order from here being that it was 12:00 at night but the pizza was fantastic. Being from Jersey, I know good pizza and it all starts with the dough. If the dough sucks it's not even worth a bite but Palazzo's dough was ON POINT. Sauce was also delicious. I'd say this place is better than Eddie and Sam's which El Pres rated in the high 7s. Great job guys. We will be back!

Had curb side delivery.  The waiter brought it out with a mask (much appreciated). Ordered the fig, goat cheese, and pork, and the Caesar salad. Both were out of this world. Best pizza I have had not just in Tucson but in many states. And the dressing on the salad - powerful but amazing. Will never order pizza from anywhere else again. Any negative reviews here are from Karens who are offended by lamb and anchovies in pizza and prefer a good ole Pizza Hut pie!

If I didn't come here on a regular basis, i would hate this bar. The service isn't good, and the overall ambiance isn't good either. However I've come here long enough not to expect anything better, and I've embraced the Philly culture. 

This is a Drexel bar, but it's also a place for Penn kids to get away from other Penn kids. Erin express is a shit show, and you're sure to have a good time even if you never leave this bar. 

There are a million tvs, so no matter what sport you want to watch, you can catch any game you would ever want to see. Come here often enough, and you'll be treated like family. Definitely a Cheers type of bar.

In case you haven't heard, it's not exactly smooth sailing in 2020 when you're trying to get married. After a change in venue in order to make our guests feel safe, we landed at Valley Green Inn. Of course, if you've ever walked by this iconic place on the Wissahickon Trail in Philadelphia, you know how beautiful a venue it is, from the building itself to the natural beauty of the landscape around it. 
But that wasn't the beauty of our event. Outside of the most beautiful bride I've ever seen, everything went so incredibly smooth. And we put it all together in barely a month. The reason? A wonderful event coordinator named Amber. She worked with us on everything from decor to price, menu to ambiance, safety to ceremony. She was simply a joy to get to know and to work with throughout the entire process. 
The food was top notch. The bartenders were friendly and quick. The lighting outside was fantastic. But as we talk about our special day we keep coming back to Amber. Your wedding day should be about one another, and not worrying every 5 minutes that something might be amiss. We were determined to push 2020 back for just one night, and couldn't be happier with the results. There was never a worry. Thank you so much Amber and thank you to Valley Green Inn!

SO good! I picked up a white pie from here last week. I met the owners. They are super friendly. It's so nice to see a building that has been empty for ages come back to life. Seriously- this pizza is delicious. 10/10 would recommend. I can't wait to come back!
Food was delicious and service was outstanding!  I would definitely recommend this restaurant to friends.

We came here from St Pete's because we saw a piece on the local news about how they had opened as a new business during the Covid19 pandemic and we wanted to support them.  We had a great experience- such friendly people and the pizza is so good!  The crust is delicious and has a great chew.  High quality ingredients and reasonable prices.  I'm picky about my pizza and this is a pie worth traveling for.  We ate very well and will be repeat customers.  Palazzo Pizza deserves the community's support.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about VGI's wedding coordinator, Amber! She's the best, incredibly hard working, funny, and brilliant at her job. Our wedding day was perfect thanks to Amber and her team. The wait staff was awesome and a lot of fun. The food was excellent, especially the mini cheese steak apps. The venue is absolutely beautiful. You have access to the entire inn (depending on what package you choose), and a covered outdoor patio with a permanent tent with beautiful string lights and (strong!) heaters. The VGI lets you use their lanterns, tea light candles, lawn games, and more. Also, your wedding cake from Bredenbeck's Bakery in Chestnut Hill is included. Amber lead us through the whole process and made sure everything was perfect. We would have been lost without her. Highly highly recommend!

Delicious! Pizza was prepared exactly like we wanted. Flavorful, fresh and crust was amazing!
We ordered delivery and service was great.

If you haven't tried this pizza it's definitely worth it. I am not a huge pizza guy, it's not something I crave often. Something about the way the dough is on their pizza, crisp outside with a airy light dough on the inside. Excellent! I recommend the sasauge rossa pizza, just get the large cause it reheats incredibly.

Omg ordered a large pepperoni pizza for myself and co workers to share as we all work at Sapphire Estate Rehabilitation Center .  We are all having a extremely busy day however,  this pizza is by far worth the money I spent to have door dash delivere it . 

So good so yummy so OMG I AM IN PIZZA  HEAVEN !!!

THANK YOU SO MUCH !!!!
One of the best pizzas in Tampa. Fresh, high quality ingredients and a remarkably friendly staff. Will definitely be one of our go-to pizza spots going forward.

Gluten Free Cheesesteak and Gluten Free subs that are truly on a level of their own.  my wife has a gluten allergy , I don't, we both love cheesesteaks and literally had them in the best places in Philly just two weeks ago. Their chipotle cheesesteaks beats the ones we had their! My wife said that was the best gluten free bread she ever had! That's big coming from her.  If you're looking for a good cheesesteak or a gluten free sandwich or gluten free sub or a gluten free cheesesteak then you have to stop by these guys!
Best pizza in Tucson, hands down. Sauce is rich and garlicky, Dough is perfect down to the crust, and my order was ready before the quoted time. Already can't wait to try it again.
Got a last minute pie right before they closed. Everyone was super nice and the pie was delicious!

If you like wasting money and don't mind your pizza burnt and paper thin, then come to this place. This is one of the worst pizzas I've ever had.   Other than being flavorless, the texture was  overly crispy. I took a bite and couldn't even touch the rest of it. Service isn't great and parking is impossible.

The food here is amazing.  I went out of curiosity and convenience, since it's right next to my house, and I was pleasantly surprised.  I returned 2 more times in the same month.  Their Mofongo is great, and their fried fish is out of this world.  There were 5 of us, and all of us were very pleased with our food.  Their portions are large and their prices very reasonable.  The only reason I gave them a 4 is because, even though they are very polite, friendly, and the food came out in a reasonable amount of time, we had to continue to ask for things that should've been provided such as napkins, utensils, a glass to pour our canned drinks into, and water.  Otherwise, I highly recommend this place, you won't be disappointed.

I have been around the world a few times and this pizza is worth a try. You can tell they are using top quality ingredients from start to finish. Hard working Authentic Italians making authentic pizza. Tampa should be proud to have the chance to taste such wonderful flavors. And the kids all loved the pizza as well and that usually doesn't happen. 
I will be back on a regular basis as this is my new go to for fantastic pizza

Not from the area but found this spot on Yelp reviews. AMAZING pizza. Got a pizza with lots of veggies. Everything was fresh and super tasty. Will definitely hit this spot again next time I am in the area.

I ordered online for a pickup at 6pm on a Friday evening. I got there a little after 6 and then hadn't even started making my pizza. I waited another 30 minutes before leaving with my pizza, salad and garlic knots. They were busy and unorganized and definitely stressed out with orders. That being said, the staff was very nice and you could tell they were hustling. 

The pizza was AWESOME! I am not a pepperoni fan but this one was definitely a good one. The spicy sausage was delicious. The garlic knots were also very tasty. You could tell the marinara was freshly made. The only thing I was less than impressed with was the Caesar salad. The presentation was beautiful with the radicchio. I did not care for the dressing, it was very salty and sour. 

All that being said, I will definitely be back for some DELICIOUS FRESH made pizza!!

Great pizza. We ordered a combo pepperoni and spicy sausage with mushroom. Very tasty...you can taste the freshness every bite. The pizza was filling, but a refreshing way. We also got the small ceasar salad. Not sure if it's not already, but the ceasar salad dressing should be sold in stores.

As a Punjabi, visiting Indian restaurants are usually average or even worse when it comes to food and service. I went with family for the lunch buffet since it was the closest indian place near our airbnb. Upon entering, we got no attention at all and werent even properly seated, just waved over to the table. The buffet only had 4 veg items and 4 chicken items. No naans and salad items did not even have a utensil to put food on to plate. All the items were room temp borderline cold. When the naans were finally put in to the warmer, I got some only to find they werent even naans but tasted like frozen paranthas. I mean come on? Definitely will not be visiting next time.

Frustrating and suspect! I called to get my wife a simple standard cleaning and exam.  Receptionist said that's not possible lol; it was literally the first time i've ever called a dentist and they told me they cannot do an exam and cleaning at the same day. I called another dentist to confirm and then called back to speak with office manager; the receptionist said she was the office manager. I asked her again and she insisted it would only be possible if they had a last-minute cancellation on a cleaning or something of that nature, this is hands-down one of the most bizarre interactions I've had.
