When I mentioned the word review to her her tone changed and all of a sudden what was impossible seemed to become possible. I told her it took an incredible amount of arguing just to get something as basic as the cleaning with a check up done I can't imagine doing anything else at their office.

I'm not sure how people said they have negative experiences here but this is the first time i ordered from here and there pepperoni pizza was amazing not only that their wings are on point i have been searching for a place that had good pizza and wings especially since I'm from Jersey they came kind of close
Pre Rona this spot used to be my ultimate dive bar bc the food was so damn good and they had a plethora of options! I miss this place just as much as I miss living in University City.

Love these guys and love this place.  My go to is the pig and fig and goat  or whatever they call it.  Can't ever remember the name but never forget the taste.  It's the best I've had in Tucson so far but I stopped looking. I'm very happy.

The Deck currently is my favorite Pizza in Tampa.  Thin crust and crispy NY style.  The kitchen is not much to look at however I've noticed several times the pride taken by the person making your pizza.  The owner is very friendly and several times that I've been there he has introduced himself and asked how the pizza was..they have a nice outdoor eating area.

I am so happy that there is a store like this in the city. It's really pretty and organized (opposed to a Jo Anne Fabrics type place) however I totally dread going in. The few times I've been in, the owner (?) has been pretty abrasive and insists on helping. I'm a do it myself kind of girl but have no issue asking for help if I need it, so having someone hovering totally stresses me out (I mean, I'm just buying some thread, jeesh).I would suggest doing some calming meditation before entering.
Hidden gem. Great lunch special. Fresh ingredients with amazing flavor! Radicchio salad is amazing.
Everything about this place is great! It's my new fav spot for brunch or meeting up with friends.

Made reservations in October for Thanksgiving.  Called twice to confirm only to be told that they no record of the reservation.  The day prior I called and I was told that they could not confirm, but could guarantee a seating for two people.  Arrived and was told they were booked.  I even gave my credit card info to hold the reservation.  A real disappointment since this was a gift for two friends.  Very unorganized and sub par.

As someone who grew up on the Upper East Side while it's not as good as some of my
Favorites from the city, it's on par with some of the best in Tucson (Fiame, Upper Crust) great service too!

Hey, it's PPP! 
Good times, good food and beverage selection (alcoholic/non) is okay as well.  I know the wings and salads are good as well! Weekends get kinda busy and you  better expect a wait, with the games & for food.
It's a great Family & adult meeting place; kids and adults have great times there together! Place to disconnect from the world while connecting with the family. Birthdays are Fun Times! ALWAYS for kids or Adults I'm one of them!
Really a very cool place with an excellent authentic neapolitan style pizza...... And a great pizza happy hour!

I have never been treated with such disrespect at a place of business before. Wish I could give this place zero stars.
I had just turned 21 a few weeks ago and came with some friends. I brought a water bottle with me because I was coming from an event on campus and the bouncers at the front didn't say it wasn't allowed in. We sat down and after not even five minutes of us being inside, a guy walked past and snatched my bottle off the table and yelled "you can't bring anything into the bar." I didn't even see his face, I just saw his hand grab my bottle. My friends looked shocked and I said "oh well, I forgot I even had that with me. I wasn't going to drink it anyway." Then the man came back 30 seconds later and said "you can't bring anything into the bar. You're done, get out." I was shocked because no one at the front told me this wasn't allowed. I told him he was free to take it because I didn't want it and that I would order something. Then he started actually screaming at me and causing a scene over three 20-something girls and a water bottle. He said I was "lying" to him and kept screaming "get out!" I said that the bouncers had seen the bottle and allowed it in and that I didn't even want it so he could take it and throw it away. And I said "why would I lie about this? I had it out on the table and wasn't trying to hide it, I forgot it was there. Just take it." He screamed "you're lying to me. you should know not to bring anything in. Get out." I had JUST turned 21 and had never been to this bar before- how was I supposed to know that? If the bouncers had said no I would have gladly thrown it away. The man kept screaming at me and causing a scene so my friends and I got up to leave, but we had to wait for out other friend who had gone into the bathroom, and that's when the man got very threatening and began to physically block our way and try to push us out, all while screaming at us. She came out from the bathroom almost immediately and I calmly said to the man as we left, "if you're going to kick people out for bringing water bottles in, then you should tell them it's not allowed at the door." And he just continued to scream "you're lying!"
I completely understand why outside beverages are not allowed in the bar and believe that is a totally reasonable rule. Even if he had told us to leave respectfully I would have understood, it's not that we got kicked out, it's that he treated us so inappropriately. If I had remembered I was carrying the bottle, I would have asked the bouncers about it and thrown it away if they had said no. I am always a courteous guest and there was no reason for me to have been screamed at in front of the entire bar and kicked out after less than 5 minutes after paying a cover. I was never rude or disrespectful to the man, I was simply telling him that he could take the bottle away and trying to understand why I was being kicked out.
I see there are a lot of rude responses to customers on the reviews here. Very poor business practice no matter how bad the customers were.
Also, they were out of wings at 9:30pm. What kind of pathetic bar runs out of wins?

Found this place on Yelp when I was looking for a quick lunch while working in the area.  Excellent service from the minute I walked in the door.  Pizza and Caesar salad were incredible!  I will definitely be back next time I'm in Tucson!

I ordered pizza from here for the first time today and was pretty disappointed. My Margherita came with no sauce on it whatsoever, the crust was alright though maybe a little on the burnt side but without sauce it was bland and barely edible.
OMGGGGGGGGG , best philly and the most fastest fries definitely looking forward to trying everything else on the menu !

Just got my UBER EATS DELIVERY and I just had to hop on to say the flounder sandwich is HUGE but salty, same for the fries. The mac n cheese is good but a bit bland ironically and then I spotted these CANNED green beans from a mile away! If you're gonna charge $2 have the decency to cook them fresh or don't call yourself a soul food restaurant with frozen fries and canned veggies :(

Well, since I've been sitting here for 25 minutes waiting for my food, I'd figured, why not write a review?

This place has nice charm, nice people, but apparently one waffle iron and cook I presume. First my server took 15 minutes to come back for my actual order, and now I've waited over 25 minutes for my actual food? I could've walked to acme that's less than a mile, brought all the ingredients (eggs, waffle, amd bacon), drove to Lowes, picked out a stove in the 40+ minutes. 

I would try this again to see if maybe this was an off day, but definitely not impressed for my first time. 

Well, I'm starving, and my food just came out, so now I'll stop writing.

Got the deliver. Packaging was nice and spill proof. Cute minimalist style. I LOVED my order it was amazing . I got the white sauce pizza (I forgot the name) I aDded mushrooms, artichoke , and peppers aaa extras all were  on there evenly dispersed on my pizza. Delightful and delectable. I got the Luna lemonade it was sooooo good it had berries or something a hint herbaceous. It was so
Good probably the best pizza I've ever had. The salad was out of this ! Out of this world  amazing . The vinaigrette was so flavorful. The lettuce so crisp and the sliced vegetables were complimentary 


My partner however got the pepperoni, he liked it . I wasn't keen on it , tasted like it shouldn't cost that much compared to my lovely meal. I really love this place not sure why the pepperoni was so greasy. My partner did say it's better cold since it was greasy. He is really into eating anything and is easy to please. 

But I on the other hand am particular so and will admit I am sensitive to salt. I preffOverall it's was a great place.  A well balanced taste that isn't focused on salt and is uSed to magnify the other flavors. Maybe it's supposed to be paired with something I'm not sure.
I called this location several times after 11am everyday this past week and no response. This is extremely unprofessional and disappointing.

Ordered delivery through Yelp, trying to help the local businesses during the shutdown, never been here before. Might have been good if the order was correct. Ordered a sausage bianca and two salads. Got a plain Bianca (it's really bland, if you were wondering) and one of the salads was wrong, too. Nothing special order, straight off the menu. Call and was offered a credit toward future order, and a "yeah we're busy, not an excuse, but that's all I can do". Sorry, lost my future business.

I am extremely frustrated. We took my pet on his first vet visit. They did not even bother to check his skin or ears- I had to actually ask. Why would you not check the wholw body? We also were going to get charged $50 for a fecal test which automatically got added to the bill and cost was never even mentioned. Now I am trying to get monthly heartworm meds for my pet which require a prescription. Girard's online pharmacy cost $10 more than the other ones I found online, such as Chewy.com. It is absurd that Girard refuses to provide a prescription with outside vendors and forces you to buy from their overpriced pharmacy. Then as I was on their pharmacy site they had a minimum $12 shipping fee! Now I probably need to see another vet who will actually work with me.

Amazing and efficient service and OUTSTANDING food! 
Some of the best pizza innTucson. We had a cáptese salad , tomatoes were fresh and flavorful, great mozzarella with just the right amount of basil and balsamic. We also had a Margarita pizza traditional style. So freaking good! I live 45 minutes from here but will definitely be making the drive accord town to enjoy these pies again and again. 100 percent recommend!

I came here for brunch. We were able to sit outside on the porch which was really nice. I ordered the mushroom, green beans, three cheese frittata special with a side fruit salad. I was pretty disappointed. The frittata was more like an omelet, but there wasn't any cheese or green beans; didn't love it. The fruit wasn't fresh at all. 
I didn't think the quality of the food matched the high price point. Pretty disappointed.

I have pics it's not letting me upload them right now but will upload them when I it allows me.

This is the third time I am updating my review and hopefully the last time as we will not be coming here anymore. We had a wonderful experience with Dr. Weiner as I posted in my first review several years ago then I had a simply horrible experience with an older woman vet who chastised me like a small child for using my phone during our office visit.(See previous review below)  Most recently we had a bad experience with Dr. Wilkerson who spent hardly any time with us at all when we went with real concerns for our cat. He seemed rushed to get in and out of the room and just ordered a full panel of blood work that cost $350. Upon walking out of the room after some assistant brought our cat back from providing his blood I overheard Dr. Wilkerson talking to a woman at the front desk about him being late for a call with his daughter's guidance counselor to get her on some sort of swim team or something like that. Seriously? I wish I didn't hear that because it just made me upset. That's simply poor customer service. However, I just hoped for the best that when the cat's bloodwork would come back that we would be provided with a diagnosis for our cat and a course of action that made sense.  When my cat's blood results came back I did not receive a phone call I received an e-mail. The e-mail said that all the blood work was fine and that they only thing they could not check for was cancer so I needed to schedule an ultrasound someplace else. The e-mail felt very cold and it incorrectly referred to my pet by a different name. It said here are the results for Brody. My cat's name is not Brody. Then when I went to a new vet that does do ultrasounds he looked at the blood-work I received from Girard Vet and let me know that it was indeed not fine. He explained why the blood-work showed early onset kidney disease. I was so grateful that I went for a second opinion and so upset that I had paid all the money I did to Girard Vet to e-mail me that my cat was fine when he isn't.

Got takeout on a holiday weekend. My order was for huevos rancheros waffle. Very slender on the toppings and the hollandaise sauce was missing. Despite that the flavors were delicious. Dulce de leche latte yum!  Bagel sandwich yum!  No sauce on the waffle

Best vet in Philly by far. As the owner of a Pit mix this the first vet that didn't make us feel like Pits are scary or bad. Super kind staff - Albert and Rebecca particularly! Cannot recommend this place enough.

Overall the staff is pretty clean, I don't see staff wiping down gaming areas while I've been there but maybe they do it on shifts? The selection of games is great and most of them do work! I hope they keep the upkeep on these machines soon! The pizza is DELICIOUS! My son really enjoy coming here for a fun day!

This is the biggest ghetto WAWA that I've ever been to.   A bunch of low class employees and patrons fighting with each other.   The cashiers need to worry more about getting the long lines moving than engaging in lengthy small talk with the customers

My wife and I love the Valley Green Inn. We come frequently with and without guests and we often give gift cards to friends. The only real issue is the server staff or waitresses. They all should be fired. They are rude and treat you as if they are doing you a favorite just waiting on you and your party.
I ate a Mangu (fried plantain) with eggs, cheese, sausage and red onion on top. It was amazing! Great price, huge plate! Best authentic Dominican food I've had in USA

Sauce tastes like it came out of a can, bitter and acidy. apparently no one at this joint knows how to add sweet basil and rosemary to balance it. The cheese they use tasted and melted like it came from Walmart. There extra large The calamari was so overcooked it was like little rock rings and the jalapeno poppers were surprisingly bland. 2 medium sized, 1 topping pizzas that they call "X-L" and a small handful of rock hard calamari and poppers out of a freezer bag= $42.75.

Then there is the fun and games with the charge. If you add your $10 tip on the tip line they demand, not ask for cash in barely discernible English. Probably because the house rips off the driver. No good deed goes unpunished.

If you mention that the calamari was overcooked the middle eastern management yells at you and says "You lie!". Incredible rude people, different management from just a few months ago.

There are too many good pizza joints in town like New York, New York to ever want to go here.

I can honestly say that this place had the worst service I have ever experienced. We waited 1hr at the table after ordering and never received our food. We couldn't even get the check for our drink order after asking for it since we couldnt wait any longer for the food. So we left what we thought we owed for the 2 drinks and went on our way..just horrific. I will never go there again and i was hosting friends from out of town..so that made the entire experience even worse.
And, I just joined yelp so I could write a review for this terrible experience.

Amazing! I had the Nutella and strawberry waffles, my friend had strawberries and cream waffles. We sat by the windows it was soooo relaxing, even after eating we sat and talked for awhile it was so comfortable. Only complaint were the flies  we were trying to kill them before our food came it was so annoying. But food was great!!

Caution : we were meeting someone here for the first time and were saddened to see that Chhaya appeared closed .. UNTIL we wandered down a few doors and found the new Chhaya ! This is a clean open space offering breakfast lunch and coffee. However, I was a bit put off by the server .. She was pushy about getting our order. We explained that we were there for a business meeting and needed time. She apologized and said she was being a little overbearing because they were slow.. Fair enough. (I've been there as a server and understand) I did continue to feel rushed for the duration of our stay though as she came and removed each persons plate as they finished eating. I enjoyed my chai and ham and cheddar sandwich. My guests had the tofu scramble and the sausage gravy waffle and enjoyed as well. It was a nice place to meet until things got busy with a mommy baby lunch group. They just about took over the restaurant. Not the restaurants fault of course ! 

Overall - food was good but small portions, service was pushy, atmosphere was nice (until the moms rolled in 20 deep), and the bill was higher than I would have expected. 

I wouldn't rush back here but it was good enough for us to have a meal.

They obviously make their hours. They zipped tied  the doors. We went to get gas and get something to eat. But lucky us these assholes decided whatever hours they want. Wawa's apparently make their own hours. 

They don't enforce any safety measure nor prevent shop lifting.

Scenic if not inconvenient location. I'm afraid the novelty of the place does a number on its quality. It's a destination because of its idyllic setting. But the room is loud (busy bar loud), service is slow and inattentive (I had to return flat soda and then ask for a straw--took 20 minutes to accomplish that). The food is underseasoned, both the home fries, and my sizable brunch burger needed additional salt. The breakfast strata was not noteworthy, the croque madame was overcooked, bacon undercooked, etc.

Add to that, the Native American wood statue just needs to go. The racism isn't becoming. $100 bill for a family of four isn't the most expensive it could be, but I had higher expectations.

Once again, cute location, bad service, underwhelming food.

Found this place for a quick bite with my kid on a Trader Joe's run.
And now I have returned many times without bothering to stop in at Trader Joe's. 
Fast, friendly, efficient service.
Good beer and wine.
Top quality salads.
And then the pizza.  Love this style of pizza - probably my favorite.  Thin crust, quality ingredients, high heat. Of course, the crust will be charred in spots. That's the style.  If you are turned off by a little carbonized crust, then this may not be the pizza place for you. 
It is the place for me.  
Definitelytop 10 (top 5?) place for pizza in Tucson.

Ok, it's come to this:
I don't always eat pizza (anymore), but when I do, I get it from Pizza Luna.
My favorite pizza in Tucson.
Eat in or order out.

wow I really have to search for a new vet. first appt with them was pretty good, doctor and staff was great. second and last appointment where do I start... first the doctor Dr.Stephanie Haugen VM made me feel like I was going to hell if I did  not neuter my dog. its something that I am highly considering but it is still a choice. you can tell me the benefits of neutering a dog without making me feel wring for if I decided not to telling me how many unwanted dogs their are in the world. I never told her twas neutering him she just took it upon her self to tell me on his next visit the things he will get including neutering. I have never had a vet not ask me my choice first and than tell why they feel I should. by the way I will be neutering him but that is not the point. second for flea and tick she persuaded me to get 3 because I would get one free knowing the brand he received last time is not the promotional one. so when I got home and only seen 3 the receptionist told me the promotion is not for that brand.this was extra money I did not have but to save in the end I felt was worth it.  lastly I have a growing pup he is 5 months and in was struggling with eating. they doctor knew this the last visit and previous. I am speechless for the last appointment which is a month difference they did not weight him, of course we can not go in due to the virus I thought I was common sense to weigh a pup esp one who you knew to having eating problems. $320.00 appt I feel that shoddy be standard but nope on the current discharge papers its the exact old weight. I have no idea how they got these reviews but I will pass on this one. I am so dissatisfied with my last appt that my next step Is to report them to the credit bureau. they are only getting a two star because the first appt was nothing like this one

Excellent breakfast place. Great service - plenty of delicious coffee. I've had the sausage gravy waffles and the Kate. Tasting my friends' food, I don't believe there's a bad piece of food on their menu.

I just got a new job very close by to Pizza Luna so I decided to stop by for lunch. I must say, this place is fantastic.

For lunch I got their lunch special which comes with a slice of pizza and a salad for $8.25. You get to choose the slice based off what's available that day, and choose the salad from the two options they have on their menu. For the pizza I went with a classic neopolitan style pizza which was kind of like a margherita pizza without the basil. It was so good!! Everything tasted fresh; it was a quality pizza for sure. I even finished the crust which is an indication of how good the pizza was. For the salad I got the Caesar. They make a garlicy Caesar dressing which, I must say, knocked my socks off. It's damn good (just be warned, you may end up with garlic breath afterwards, haha). The only (not-major) complaint I have with the salad is the size of the lettuce.... I brought my salad into a work meeting without realizing how large the pieces were. It was pretty funny trying to discreetly shove large pieces of lettuce into my mouth as my boss spoke, lol. It just needs to be chopped up a little bit. 

I didn't get anything to drink but they offer a variety of beers, wines, soda, and more. The interior of the restaurant is very pretty. It has a modern look to it but still feels welcoming. All the employees were very friendly and helpful as well.

Overall I would say this is one of the better pizza joints in town. It's fantastic to know there's an excellent pizza place on the east side of town. I highly recommend it!

Wasn't going to post but nearly a month later I'm still thinking of how awful our President's Day lunch was. The only thing that we had no complaints on was a bowl of plain ice cream for dessert. We visited with 6 guests, including a family member from England to whom we raved about this classic dining establishment. We ordered the Mac and cheese appetizer - amazingly overpriced!!!!, 2 burgers- ordered medium well and received rare, chunks of fat on both pork cheesesteaks (was barely chewable), but the absolute worst item was the apple coffee crumble which was was a ramekin with sliced apples, coffee grounds, and melted ice cream. The coffee grounds were so thick you had to chew them. This was a meal over $125. Will not be back especially after the embarrassment of bringing our out of town guest.
I have to take it all back. The chef has apparently left. From watery drinks to gluey potatoes over cooked protein and slow inattentive service. Thus one nice restaurant earns one star.

I had the fig, pig and goat pizza and it was the best pizza I have ever eaten! So glad I was told by a friend and can't wait to go back!!

Jill Reilly

This business is Extremely Unprofessional! 
If the service is any indication on how the food taste caution!!! Do not to do business with this company due to the following :
Poor customer services, they never pick up their phone and will only communicate via email and that's not ver frequent. 
Lack of final follow-up and invoicing for catering orders. However when I called to complain about the unprofessionalism I receive excessive phone calls on my personal phone Excessive phone early in the morning and then a text message refusing to honor proper service. 
This company is a joke don't bother!

The pizza was delicious, one small margerita pie and one small meatball pie. It arrived hot, the crust crisp on the bottom.  Excellent  sauce and seasonings. 
We very much enjoyed it!

It was so nice to sit outside and be able to look at the water! This is a dog friendly restaurant which makes it really fun. But to the food...BEST Truffle Parmesan fries I've had! Amazing. I got the steak frites for $20. Great value and a ton of fries. And the fries were just perfectly cooked. The steak was really good too. The waiters were very nice also. Will definitely be going back.

This was one of the best pizzas I've had in years! Hot and fresh with amazing fresh mozzarella. Crust was crisp and not soggy. The side salad with green goddess dressing was phenomenal, those little lardons were perfect. I absolutely loved it and I can't wait to come back to Tuscon for another one.

This was really good pizza, and a really interesting restaurant! I ordered a large pepperoni to go, and while I waited, I watched them prepare and cook it, since the kitchen is completely visible from the tables. The pizza was enough for 4 people (or 2 with leftovers) and it tasted fresh and homemade. While it was a little more expensive than I'd normally prefer, and the cheese sometimes didn't want to stay on the pizza, the taste and whality was way better than any chain restaurant, so it was worth it!

I had hoped for a great little wood-fired pizza shop close by and I got it! Turns out it's not wood-fires but the specialized very hot oven gives you that same crisp bottom and lightly charred edges. Great dough flavor and texture, plenty of sauce and high-quality topping choices. They have a few beers and wines, Mexican Coke, unique salads, garlic knots. Please buy their pizzas and ensure they are here for the long haul! So delicious!!!!

I've gone to Girard Vet Clinic a few times now with my two dogs. It was mostly convenience because I just moved to the neighborhood.
For the most part, everyone has been very friendly. However, since COVID, things have seemed to go a little downhill. I understand why they are not allowing people inside the building until their appointment time,  but last time I was there I was left waiting outside for almost 1.5 hours after my appointment was to start. It's not easy standing outside with two dogs with no where to sit for 1.5 hours. 
When we do finally see the doc, they are friendly enough, but I'm always left in awe of how much money I've spent and I never really know what it is for, even after I ask clarifying questions. Labs for this, tests for that, etc. I don't think I've ever left that building without spending $400. If you are looking for something cheap or low-cost, definitely look elsewhere.
I would also be very careful if scheduling a dental procedure. I was told on the phone that dental is about $600-$650 (already very expensive), and then when my dog was all said it done, it was about $1400. This was due to "necessary" tooth extractions that I had apparently agreed to. I understand sometimes that teeth need to be removed and maybe the price would go up a little, but my God, you think you could warn someone when their bill is going to be $800 dollars more than the already expensive quoted price?? We've been here several times but now I believe it's time we look elsewhere.

Today I saw Alex at AMS for a haircut. 

 First time here for me as my quest for a great haircut had come to a dead end.
  I get a very short cut.  The lines for a short cut are more defined for good or bad and I have had mostly bad. I do not mind paying for a skilled hairdresser.  Sadly, the unskilled and skilled can charge the same.
If you give me a great cut, a comfortable salon, I  will follow you anywhere.  Looks like that is the case here.

We went here recently on a whim, and I was very pleasantly surprised.  Gone was the ketchuppy cardboard pizza from my youth.  The cheese bread was a yummy start to our meal, and the pizza itself was on par with some of the more inexpensive delivery places.  My hubby was glad to have a half pitcher of beer, because he isn't a fan of crowds.  I would recommend trying to find a coupon.  One day after we went, one came in an advertisement in the mail.  My 2 and 3 year old had a lot of fun playing games and riding the carousel after dinner.  We will be back soon.
I love this place. I live down the street and the employees are always funny and cool to talk to. Art and Brian are the best. Great prices, nice selection, fun place. I love you Midtown Liquors.

Came here after yoga in passyunk... very cute little spot. Had vegan and vegetarian options so I got a toffuti bagel with vegan meat on it. Great coffee here too. They've got outdoor seating, indoor seating by the windows, and two sided bar seating too. Loved my experience here.

Randomly stumbled upon this place while strolling around the neighborhood. It was fine. The food was pretty decent, but oh my, service is as slow as can be. The large pipe above my head sprayed some water on me, so that was interesting. We ended up moving to the next table to avoid the water. 

The huevos rancheros waffle is unique and delicious. The turkey panini was decent too and is pressed on a waffle maker (out of laziness or creativity? No clue). 

Not a bad place to randomly stumble upon but not somewhere I'd actively seek to revisit.

My best friend and I ordered from here via UberEats and felt compelled to leave a stellar review because the food was dank, for lack of a better term.

Our entrees, baked ziti & spaghetti, tasted so good that i literally started tearing up. After taking a bite of our desserts, red velvet cake & tiramisu, i'm pretty sure God looked me directly in the eye; it was really good.

Not sure what all the negative reviews are about, but they seem a little bitter and over dramatic, so don't let them sway your initial impression.

Came here for lunch today after a nice morning hike. We didn't have reservations and were able to be seated inside without any wait. 

I ordered the veggie burger which was very good. It's supposed to come with avocado but i didn't get any avocado. The aioli is good. It's served with a side salad which is a bed of mixed greens lightly dressed. 

My boyfriend ordered the bacon wrapped meatloaf served with string beans, garlic mashed potatoes and onion rings. He said it was delicious. I tried the potatoes and thought they were cold/ luke warm. 

Our waiter was friendly and nice. 

I'm not sure where all the bad reviews are coming from. Everyone at the restaurant today seemed very pleased with their meal. 

Lose 1 star for forgetting the avocado, bland side salad and cold mashed potatoes. 

We will definitely return the next time we go to wissahickon for a hike!

I go here every Thursday for wing night and $5 Jager shots. They have the best wings in town and they're only 75 cents!! The service is great and the DJ is always playin the hottest tunes! Dance floor ready! 

First off, let me start with the wings! Packed with flavor and the perfect amount of crispy/crunchy. Not breaded though! I usually get mild but next time I want to try the garlic parm. The blue cheese is even a little different than most places, excellent of coarse! 

For the past few weeks, Jagermeister girls have been coming in handing out free shots and swag! Who does that!! :) so awesome and Jager is my favorite!

Salads and slices and pies, oh my! Salads and slices and pies!

Pizza Luna did what I see as a pretty smart thing. They limited their menu to several salads and pies (12" or 16") or slices based on a pie that is either Bianca or a Rossa (white or red sauce) + toppings, toppings, toppings. I counted their toppings and I think it works out to 1,536 possible pizza combinations! (Hint: If you can't find a combination of base and toppings that suits you, Pizza Luna is not the problem.) You'd need a fork lift for 16" with everything.

Tucson casual, friendly staff, little samples at the counter where you give them your order ... and a relatively trendy atmosphere, quiet enough to have a conversation without using semaphore. 

If they're open and you're hungry, it's worth the stop ... even if it's a little out of the way for you.

First time to Pizza Luna.  Decided to try based on glowing reviews on Next Door for Tanque Verde area.  Net review is... this is outstanding pizza.  Might be the best pizza I've ever had.  Tried the Sausage Rossa and the Neapolitan Meatball with mushrooms added for take out.  Hard to say which one is better, they were both phenomenal.  Small pizza is definitely large enough for one.  Online ordering via their website was simple.  Highly recommend.

This place has just become my favorite restaurant in the entire Philadelphia area.   It is spectacular!  I've ridden by this place countless times on a mountain bike , and I finally got a chance to try it. What an experience! The atmosphere is obviously very interesting...lots of history and culture. The service was delightful - anyone who says differently is probably a silver-spooned snob. Parking might sometimes be...interesting, but it just adds to the fun of going to this place. It's in the middle of nowhere, nestled quietly along Forbidden Drive. Google it and wow yourself with the history...pretty neat!  I really can't wait to go back to this place...it's open every single day of the year (yes, even THAT day), and I plan on going here many many more times throughout life.
They serve up a quality slice of pizza. Good ingredients and delicious crust! I ordered a happy hour slice and stood in line to get into Trader Joe's , it was perfect.

Not good food at all. The only thing I actually enjoyed was an empanada, if I could give them a 0 star I would. Oh  and they only accept cash and be ready to pay an atm surcharge to pay for the food. As far as a 1 $, they are way over priced for the quality.

This sweet little place is completely a slice of heaven! Go for the Fig and Pig pizza-- simply elegant and classy tasting. Have a bottle of red wine, order some fresh garlicky salad and you'll go home happy! I just wish I lived closer to this pizza place!
D'Lysh catered my sororities black history month event. Food and customer service were both great! Will definitely be ordering from here again :)

Girard Veterinary will NOT release prescriptions and requires their customers to purchase through their in-house store (Vet's First Choice).  The prices are HIGH and they do not price match with Chewy or Petmeds, who I typically like to order with.  They have a whacked out $10 "handling" charge that is added on to all their orders, whether or not you pick up in the store AND even with their Sales/Rebates the prices are significantly higher than purchasing from other vendors.  There are too many issues and surprises with this Vet & I will not be returning.

We've been here about 4 times during the pandemic, usually getting the lunch special slice and a salad and eating in our car. I've loved the Caesar salad every time. The dressing is bonkers good. Use it to dip some crust in. Perfection. I've tried a sausage slice, sausage mushroom slice, and a sausage bianca, and I think the sausage mushroom with marinara is my favorite. My wife gets the Margherita slice every time and loves it.  The lunch special is like $9 and super filling for a giant slice the size of your face and a big salad. Super good deal. Also the garlic knots are really tasty and it's only $3 for an order of 6 which is more than enough for 2-3 people. Love it here.

Can this place get less than one star for being the most racist bar in Philadelphia? Asshole bar people kicked me out for no reason. I brought a beer in from previous bar but I made that mistake. They then kicked me out and man handled me and told me I spilled beer in the workers faces which was false. They are a bunch of ingrate idiots who don't understand basic human rights and are totally racist. Never ever go here if you value diversity and being treated with respect.

I've said many times that we are living in The Golden Age Of Pizza. Pizza Luna is one of those reasons why. Their crust is awesome, a word that is tossed around too carelessly and should be properly reserved for cases like this. Their attention to ingredients is evident. Their basic "plain" Neapolitan is a delight. Their specialty pizzas are well thought out. The fig, pig, and goat was especially good for when you want to go beyond the basics. If this pizza isn't the best I've ever had, it is at least good enough to shove my memories of all other pizzas aside. This is the place. Accept no substitutes.

Amazing! Their Caesar salad is the best I have ever had! We usually pair that with the fig and pig pizza... seriously, to-go, crack open a nice bottle of
Red wine and put on a cheezy horror flick and you're slam dunk into a perfect date night (although the tots will come to about $$30 with tip )
Ordered online through Yelp for takeout. Pizza might be the best in Tucson. The sauce is second to none
my family and i ordered the fig pizza months ago and i've been thinking about it since!!
Awesome, fast service. Pizza is great. Salads need a little more pizazz. When I say pizazz, a few extra ingredients.

I found this great little Dominican restaurant, named Sabor a Merengue, located in a shopping plaza along Waters Avenue, right near the intersection of Hanley Road. 

I knew that Dominican cuisine features Mofongo, which is a Puerto Rican dish made with fried plantains as its main ingredient. Plantains are picked green and mashed with salt and water in a wooden pilón (mortar and pestle). The cook produces a tight ball of mashed plantains that absorbs the flavors of the vegetables, meats, and seasonings. Most dressings and mixtures include broth, garlic, and olive oil. 

It was my plan to order some Mofongo for lunch, until I saw all of the steam table daily specials. Dominican cuisine is new to me, but I saw a lot of my favorite Latin & Spanish favorites, so I certainly felt right at home.

Sitting out on the steam tables, they had roast pork, fried pork skin, fried pork chops, Longaniza sausages, grilled chicken, pepper chicken, garlic chicken, fried chicken, baked chicken, chicken stew......wow, the list just went on and on. The roast chicken looked fabulous as it had some of the crispy pork skin mixed in. That came with Moro de Habichuelas made with yellow rice and black beans (like a traditional moro rice). This delicious platter of food cost $8. YUM!!!!

If you prefer to order off the menu, you can select many of these same items, along with appetizers, soups, Mofongo, beef, fish, seafood, desserts, and my personal favorite -- De Todo un Poco platter. That translates into a little bit of everything, and for about $25 you will be served fried beef, Spanish sausage, fried chicken Dominican-style, and salami with fried plantains. If you're a breakfast person, Sabor a Merengue opens early, and they have egg platters, breakfast sammies, and strong coffee for their customers.

This was a fun way to sample some new cuisine, and I plan on going back to try a few other things off their menu.
Dr. Tancredi was kind and answered all my questions when I brought in my newly-adopted heartworm-positive dog. Metered street parking isn't too hard to find within a block.

It is hard to believe that a place off the beaten track has such a wide array of choices expertly prepared by skilled chefs. The items I ordered were packaged expertly and delivered piping hot and the food was so good. I especially enjoyed their sushi and sashimi.  I discovered my dog likes sashimi, so I had to share. Lol.
I highly recommend you try this place just based on their wide array of selection and very reasonable pricing.

My husband & I dined here for brunch on our one year anniversary. We arrived at our 11am reservation time and were promptly seated outside. Our waitress came over quite quickly after we were seated. I ordered a coffee and a mimosa, and my hubby got a beer & coffee. Coffee was nice & hot, and the mimosa was filled to the top, with plenty of champagne.

The meals have 2 set prices, depending on what you get. They all come with your choice of soup, house salad, Caesar salad, or fruit salad. They also bring you out a basket of baked goods, like muffins, scones, sweet breads, etc. I tried a banana bread muffin and some sort of spiced sweet bread. They were both good.

Hubby chose house salad and pecan waffles. Most entrees came with sides of potatoes & sausage. He ate every bite.

I had potato leek soup & filet benedict. Soup was nice & hot & had a great flavor. Filet benedict was delicous--steak cooked perfectly, hollandaise sauce was light & not too lemony like it can be sometimes. 

Food was delicious, ambiance is nice--right in Wissahickon Creek Park. You can people watch if you sit outside. 

I will be coming back!

Checked Yelp to find a new and highly rated pizza spot to try. My husband and I wanted to pick up a pie on the way home to have while watching some Sunday Night Football. Seems Pizza Luna is only doing takeout and delivery during COVID. My husband went in to pick up our pizza so I can't comment on the cleanliness or atmosphere, but the guy who took our order over the phone was nice.

We got a large pie, half Chicken Chorizo and half Neopolitan Meatball. They were both really good. I liked the flavors of the Chicken Chorizo maybe slightly better. The onions and Manchego cheese made it. The crust was really good, ever-so-slightly slightly charred but still very chewy and not too thick. The specialty pizzas all sounded really good and were different than your typical pizzeria. I guess that's the Neo-Neopolitan style they describe!

I live a good 30-40 minutes from here, so while I may not drive that far to get a Pizza Luna pie frequently, I definitely want to return and try some more of the menu.

Had their Bianca(white) pizza with the addition of mushrooms. Fresh oregano, a nice flavor enhancer, was added. It was done in just a few minutes and delivered piping hot. Their neo-neapolitan crust was crisp however I do prefer my crust cooked to a golden brown. It was just shy of that but I'm sure next time I can request that.  The flavor was good but the mozzarella wasn't as rich as I would have liked. Will try another cheese selection next time. Comfy upscale decor and friendly welcoming staff. They have an $8 lunch special which includes a slice and salad. Beer and wine will be coming very soon. I was told their sausage is made in-house and another customer said the sweet fennel sausage is very good. Diverse menu with some items not found at other local pizza shops like lamb sausage and radicchio salad.  Will definitely return and recommend to others.

I have ordered from Cavanaughs countless times during this pandemic, and I have to say, you can't beat the portion for price. They also have a pretty good selection of items so it's entirely possible to order something new every time.  I would say that about 90% of the time I am satisfied with my meal.  The issues I have had, for those wondering, is the chicken Parmesan sandwich (which is my favorite kind of sandwich) often is under sauced and occasionally is way over cooked,making the chicken rubbery.  
.... actually that's the only issue I have had. Sometimes the fries get a little soggy in the box but it's definitely a more sustainable option to keep them in the same box so I kinda don't mind it. 

Anyways, when I have had issues, I've been refunded thru Uber eats, and none of the issues I have had have made me want to give them up. They're dependable.
Delicious food, excellent service!  This was our first time here - we will definitely be back!  The salad and garlic knots are so good!  Pizza was amazing as well - 5 stars all around!

Highly recommend this place for their lobster mac n cheese, calamari and french onion soup.  I've tried the steak twice their and was not the biggest fan.  I do think they have some other incredible things on their menu that I would like to come back and try!

Three weeks have gone by and I have received no test results from my dog's exam. Dr. Balzar has not signed off on my dog's Heartguard meds. When I called to ask why I was told "because the doctor doesn't like to promote anything other than what we sell behind the counter". When I asked for an estimate of when the doctor would sign off on the Heartguard, whoever I was speaking to on phone was very short and rude to me and replied "I don't know". 

I called today and switched to another vet. So happy to be away from Girard Vet clinic. 

*To be fair, there are two people who work behind the counter at this vet office. One is very rude and incompetent, and the other has a nicer tone and is more patient. If you call, ask for Jennifer.
Very clean good Dominican food.Simple good tasting food.Carne de res is tasty..Make sure you get the sauce on the rice.Get the limonada drink.

We tried Pizza Luna on a whim on a Friday night and it was BUSY! One of the better places on the east side to grab a pizza. I really enjoyed their half pepperoni and half Neapolitan. The garlic flavor was a bit strong for us but we really enjoyed the flavor of the sauce and the texture of the crust. Can't wait to come back, just be sure to order ahead on weekends! We want to try their par baked pizzas next.

Not sure how or why this place has so many good reviews. I've been a dog owner for all my life and have had many different dogs and used different vets and this is my least favorite vet office. I just moved to the neighborhood a few months ago and made an appointment for my dog's yearly checkup and shots. Girard Vet canceled my appointment 48 hours prior to the visit (which was fine) but when I asked to reschedule, they told me they had no room for me in the upcoming two weeks and said the best I could do was a walk-in.

I did a walk in and waited in the waiting room for two hours. When it was finally my turn, Dr. Balzar couldn't find my dog's paperwork and told me to go in the next room and "figure it out". I called my previous vet who said they had definitely faxed over the paperwork and didn't understand the problem. 

After waiting another half hour in the next room, and when I finally saw Dr. Balzar again, she said, "so which shots are we giving your dog?" I was like, "YOU'RE the vet, you have my dog's files, YOU tell me". When I asked her opinion about new flea and tick medication, she kept saying "you're the mom". I was like, why am I even here? 

The first thing I noticed is that Dr. Balzar had a fake/cheery personality and seemed to be very uncomfortable around animals. My dog is the friendliest, people-loving dog. He went to lick her face and she jumped back, saying, "he's trying to bite me!"

When I came back into the waiting room, a dog with a giant cyst was bleeding onto the floor and the nurse and doctor were doing nothing about it. In fact, dr. Balzar barely even acknowledged the dog. How is this woman a vet? Does she even like animals?

Two weeks later and I still have not heard the results of my dog's fecal test. Super unhappy with this place and I will not be going back.

I'm a Flatbed OTR Truck Driver and try and find the time to visit Vape Shops all around the U.S. in my travels. I visited Litmist and was greeted by Sean (Shawn?, *sp) and he was extremely patient and helpful, as I had a Mod that needed some TLC.  He was nice enough to take the mod apart and try and fix it. I've been to many shops and NO ONE could fix it or even gave it half the look that Sean did. I met Rena (*sp) as well. Very nice as she helped me with my new Smok 12 Tank and the both of them were just all together friendly, welcoming, and it felt like a cool place to chill out, which to me, is what a vape shop should feel like.  Their house juices are interesting and the flavors are great. The fact that they can mix sweetener on the spot I think is pretty cool too. You can decide what level of nicotine you want and they provide it for you with your choice of juice in an excellent bottle.  $25 for 120ml juice is damn good too! over all I def will visit them again if I am in the area. 

I do wish they had there juices available to be tasted through a mod instead of putting a dab on my hand and tasting it. Juices can always tasted different out of the mod, and will always taste much richer in it's natural form. But thats just me, it would NOT stop me from going to visit Sean and Rena again next time I'm in town.

This place is the shizznitzzz. Wish I was always 10. Pizza is not the best but decently priced for what you get. And the games are awesome. Its huge so they having lots of seating for birthday parties or casual diners. I love coming here for my nieces and nephews bday. Lots of games for the little one plus they have a small roller coaster and a merry-go-round! The big prize selection isnt so great but I love the small toy gadgets. Like the ones I use to get when I was little.  If I was still 10, I would want my bday parties here all the time.

Wow how lucky am I to be working right in front of this place today. Very clean! I love the vibe of this place. The employees are very friendly. Has little tables and chairs outside on the sidewalk so you can enjoy outdoor eating. I watched people coming and going for a while. Seems everyone knows everyone. They stop to say hello. Very friendly community. 
I ordered the Waffle French Toast. It tastes amazing! The berries they place on top of it are super fresh. Just the right amount of powdered sugar. Comes with the syrup on the side. It's perfect. They have many coffee drinks to choose from. 
The pictures just don't do justice I promise you.

Tucson has another quality pizza establishment to enjoy and I'm very happy they are only a few minutes drive from where I live. Pizza Luna, thank you for existing! Pizza Luna specializes in Neapolitan-style pizza and, while I was excited this restaurant was opening, I was a bit leery because I've had some rather poor Neapolitan pizza in my days.

I had nothing to fear here. I strolled in for lunch in mid-afternoon on a Wednesday to find a cozy, but well-designed restaurant and a very friendly staff. I had a slice of Pizza Margherita and a slice of Pizza Blanca for lunch and took home a whole pie of the Pizza Sausage Rossa. Yea, this pizza is excellent! A crispy, tasty, thin crust with quality ingredients that makes this pizza crave-worthy. You just can't have one slice at a time ~ heck, I had three and then took a whole pizza home! 

They also offer soft drinks, wine, and beer on the premises. There is an outdoor seating area, which is where I placed myself for lunch. The interior decor has a black & white motif, is quite stylish, and attractive. I'd say the place can seat maybe 20-30 people on the inside plus 10-20 more seats outside. 

I will definitely be back here, likely quite often, to get my pizza fix. Keep up the great work, Pizza Luna!

If your going to be open at least be attentive ....kids were waiting for  awhile waiting to redeem their tickets....staff is bunch of idc kids too busy hanging with other staff In the back....half games are closed which I get BUT with less people in attendance the staff has less to deal with and should be more involved In goings on
I've ordered here several times and it's fantastic. Great people and even better pizza!

As far as typical Chinese fare goes, this place has good lo mein, quality chicken, and tasty dumplings. I also got to try pizza rolls for the first time, and I was pretty impressed with how it tasted! Crispy egg roll with lots of cheese on the inside, I was definitely a fan. Food was ready for pick up quickly and they added extra soy sauces, duck sauces and mustards, they don't skimp on the dippings! Would love to try some of the other platters from here, so if I ever make it down to the area, would definitely try again.

So I install PVC fencing and had a customer under one of there HOAs. I tried calling them to ask what paperwork they needed from me to install a job inside there HOA. 
They told me and the home owner different things and got upset when I asked them how there process  worked. They couldn't find the information based on the homeowner's address or name.
They were rude most of the conversation.
They rudely stated that if I am indeed a real fencing company I should already know how there HAO works

In short they are unprofessional even to other companies.

For the second year in a row, I joined a group of about 60 people here for a post game gathering after seeing St Joe's at the Palestra.  We come here because they are big enough to accomodate us in their downstairs area.  

Food-wise, it may be hard to judge them based on a buffet style appetizer meal.  Not sure if this is indicative of their overall quality.  I will say that of everything I tried, the buffalo wings and ribs were my favorite, with some decent fries too.  The chili, Caesar salad, and breaded chicken bites left a little to be desired, especially the chili which was flavorless and watery in this setting.  But for about 15 bucks a person including draft beer, it came out to a good deal for our group.  

It's an OK choice if you are in the area.  Probably worth it for the wings which were flavorful and meaty.  Definitely more of a local college bar.

So I ordered mac n cheese from Cavanaugh's restaurant today and it was good.  I called the restaurant to ask who did the cooking today because I had it yesterday also and it was crazy and so was the last 3 times before that.  The manager or owner got all in his feelings and said I don't like you calling my food crap.  I said you should be glad that you're getting the truth from a customer that continues to patronize you during a pandemic and wants to support your business, and your response couldhave been I will talk with my staff so we can have consistency in the restaurant/kitchen.  NO you want to yell and be rude to your customer who does that.  Your customer service skills need lots of help, you should be retrained in how to deal with the public because you'll have to deal with all kinds of people and opinions.  SO MY GOOD PEOPLE WHY SHOULD WE CONTINUE TO SUPPORT AND PATRONIZE A RESTAURANT THAT DOES NOT TREAT THEIR CUSTOMERS RIGHT.  YOU, Cavanaugh's just lost a large family.  E will not be coming back.

Just picked up the fig, pig and goat cheese pizza. Great crust, my personal preference would have been for a little more fig and balsamic reduction drizzle. This was my first visit and I will definitely be back to try some more pizzas.

Visiting the Tampa Bay Area and looking for Great authentic Pizza at a good price! We couldn't be more happy with choosing Palazzos! The Lion was amazing and the Greek salad was the best salad I've ever had at a pizza joint. We received the wrong pizza from the Grubhub driver and the Owner personally delivered the correct pizza himself promptly. Would definitely recommend and return myself!

I really don't leave many reviews but today I felt strongly about thanking Armando at the Park Mall Peter Piper location.. I always see him here working so hard and always being kind and helpful to people. Above and beyond that he is a wonderful cook and that's why I'm leaving this review; I have been here many times over the years as well as other locations and this is by far the best person to make your pizza and wings etc. I never want to see anyone go unappreciated so I have to compliment him and his crew of workers here today. It's been the best service I've had in a long time.
Has to be the best Meat Lover's pizza I've had in Tampa. Great vibe, awesome music, super convenient location. All around an amazing place to grab a slice.
Honestly it's probably right up there with my favorites. There's not many pizzas I've eaten whole without picking apart and this was definitely one of them. It was sooooo yummy!!

Pizza Luna is so yummy!  We always come here when we're in Tucson.

The crust is perfect and the toppings are delish.  I can't wait to move to Tucson so we can come here more often!

I am new to the east side of Tucson but I'm loving it!!! One of my favorite aspects of dining out here is the pizza!!!  There are already two great places on the east side and now Pizza Luna makes a third.  
This place is really my kinda pizza.  I love how thin and crispy it is, how quickly it comes out and how great the service is every single time. I've only tried two of their pies but both are absolutely the best I've had in town...maybe anywhere!!!! There is a specialty pie (who's name escapes me) but it's made w a white sauce with sausage, peppers and mushrooms. It's absolutely phenomenal as is their standard pepperoni.  From the sauce to the cheese and the ridiculous crust, everything about this pizza just blew me away. I'd even consider giving this restaurant 5 stars, but they really don't have much to drink.  
 I'm not a drinker, and they seem to focus mostly on beer and wine.   There isn't any tea and they have coke in the bottle and some sparkling water.  They do have a house-made lemaonade that is pretty great but I'd really prefer a few more offerings and certainly iced tea!   
Their salads are also to freaking die for and, once again, the service is always spot on.
It's a rather small place so get their early.  If you want Tucson's best pizza...look no further than a Pizza Luna!
Very disappointed. I waited 30 mins for my food to be given this. Chicken on a slice of bread. Rice is very bland and Mac and cheese is alright.
Friendly staff and great cheese pizza and garlic knots. The cinnamon toast crunch is a great way to end your meal too. We will definitely be back soon.
Wow!  Amazing pizza!  So much flavor!  Oh, and the crust is amazing!  I could totally eat a plate of just crusts!

Love this place! It is one of my go-to places for breakfast or brunch. It gets crowded on Saturday/Sunday mornings, but what brunch place doesn't?? It's a cute little place with a relaxing atmosphere. It's one of those places I even feel comfortable going by myself if I want to because they have a little bar area for people to sit as well. All the food I've gotten from here has been excellent. I've never had a complaint. And their coffee drinks are yummy!
Pizza was on point!! Great flavor, perfect crust, thin but not too thin. Amazing customer service as well.

My wife and I eat at a lot of local restaurants. Tonight was our second time visiting Pizza Luna and we were eager to take friends visiting from out of town. On both trips the food was excellent, the attention to detail and ingredients used at Pizza Luna are truly incredible. Truth be told, we would become regulars here just for the consistency and quality of the food. Tonight we had Travis serve us and he went above and beyond to ensure we had a great experience. Our entire party agreed and the service we received was the best we have had in years. Thank you for so effortlessly making amazing pizza and having a staff passionate about a great experience. We will be back soon!

Not bad but not great and overpriced for what it was. Very spotty service today. Would not go back to it for a special occasion and if I was in the area there are better places to enjoy. This is a quaint spot and it's priced a little high because it's a tourist trap in as much as there is no immediate competition. However a simple lunch should not run you $70 and the waitress zinged is by suggesting to add "a protein" to my salad.  That single running sloppy and not very tasty crab cake doubled the cost of my very small and slightly overpriced Caesar salad from $12 to $24. It was hardly worth it. 

The wine and beer list is mediocre and the very young and inexperienced waitress left me to have to go hunt for a beer glass. If you are going to charge upscale prices in an upscale neighborhood the food and the service should be up to par. Today was not so much. Nothing on the menu made me want to return and try VGI again. I can do better locally.

I would give this place no stars but really I think it's mostly the vets that are so horrible while the rest of the staff is usually warm and helpful. I've been bringing my old dog here since we moved to the neighborhood over a year ago. I was surprised when my old dog who hates the vet actually seemed to enjoy Girard Vet Clinic. The first few times we came we saw Dr Wilkerson and my husband and I were really happy with how the vet treated our dog. He seemed very engaged and thoughtful. A while later we started seeing Dr Moody at every appointment. Not that we were given a choice, Im not sure anyone is given a choice on which vet they see. For a while we were fine with this because Dr Moody seemed nice enough. Things started going horribly wrong when we would bring our old dog in different things and Dr Moody would order tests with any conclusions afterwards. My husband and I actually started feeling scammed. One time our dog has a cyst on his face and the vet sent the fluid to pathology. When the vet got the pathology results she didn't call she sent us an email saying she didn't know what the cyst was but she recommended we put our 13 year old through surgery. Dr Moody then sent us a separate email with the estimate to do surgery and THEN recommend we call and schedule ASAP. This made me angry and when I asked to speak with a vet Dr Wilkerson came out listened, agreed with my concerns and said he would talk with Dr Moody about getting clearer pathology results and then they would call us within the next few days. No one ever called.

A similar situation has happened since but with more expensive xrays and every single time we see Dr Moody it seems like maybe she doesn't actually know us even though we see her frequently through the year for normal blood work and old age related issues. She forgot what she had prescibed our dog and it's become pretty obvious she doesn't care about our dog or us as people and paying customers.  When we have ever tried to complain or even just ask for an explanation of a diagnosis we can't seem to ever get a vet on the phone and no one ever ends up calling us back.

Normally I take my dog to this vet for her usual checkups and for any other incidents that pop up (& have been taking her here since we rescued her over 2 years ago). It was just a short walk from my home as well so I love to support locally whenever possible but unfortunately they have permanently lost me as a customer after today.

My dog was bit by a raccoon yesterday evening, after usual business hours so I took her to the Penn emergency vet and they said she was okay to go home and to just get a rabies booster the following day with her regular vet. I was relieved and thought great, no problem! 
I called and left a voicemail so that in the morning we could arrange for her to come in. 
I never received a returned phone call so I called again to follow up and after explaining my situation again they said no they could not take her at any time today. Could not even squeeze her in for a booster shot?! Still no. The receptionist was not even slightly accommodating by offering another date or suggesting what I should do or even slightly understanding/apologetic for the given situation. 

It's a shame too because Dr.Wilkerson is a great Vet but I'll be taking my fur baby elsewhere after today.

the location is absolutely fabulous, and i echo other yelpers' sentiments on the charm of feeling like you're a million miles from the city when you're in wissahickon valley park.

my friend and i came for sunday brunch, and by noon, the park was already packed full of hikers, bikers, picnic-ers, and families of all sorts out enjoying the beautiful weather and a relaxing day by the creek. we parked a ways away because the lower lot closest to valley green inn fills up pretty early on. but it's a peaceful and leisurely walk to the restaurant, so enjoy!

the interior of the restaurant is very rustic and log cabin-esque. in a word: charming. but while i appreciate the atmosphere and the setting, our experience was completely overshadowed by the horrible service we encountered upon arriving.

for the first half hour we were there, there wasn't even a hostess to greet us. we (and everyone that came before and after us for about a good 45 minute period of time) stood in the reception area waiting to be acknowledged... and it never happened. apparently the hostess was off somewhere resetting tables for a large party. but um, is that her job? it's not like they were understaffed, so it was incomprehensible to me that they couldn't direct other staff members to do that. 

after about 20 minutes of waiting, a waiter came by and took our names to be placed on the waiting list. but 1) there were plenty of open tables everywhere.. both inside the restaurant and out on the front patio. so really, had there been someone to check us in and seat us, it shouldn't have taken more than 10 minutes to seat everyone; and 2) by the time the hostess finally came back to man the front desk (another 20 mins later), our name had magically disappeared, and we had to tell her again to re-place us on the waiting list. what was the point of the waiter taking our name then?!

sunday brunch is prix fixe at $18.95 and comes with your choice of soup/salad, assorted pastries, and coffee/tea/juice. personally, i would've preferred an equally priced sunday brunch in the city that includes an alcoholic drink. 

my friend and i shared the fruity french toast, which is essentially challah french toast drenched in a raspberry compote. the raspberry was too sweet and an overkill on the french toast, but the accompanying sausage and potatoes were decent. overall, a mediocre brunch. oh, and they ran out of fruit salad so we had to settle for house salad.

so, to sum it up:
- excellent location
- mediocre, overpriced food (brunch)
- inefficient organization
- snail's pace service.. perhaps a la rustic mode?

very tempted to give them 2 stars, but the location saves them. just barely.

Hands down my favorite pizza in town! I always just try to eat a slice or two but can EASILY eat a whole pizza! It's just that good. Great happy hour/lunch specials! Definitely the place to go if you want some really good pizza.
This place is good. The previous owners were better but is  good to have a nice Dominican spot in tampa. Tampa is not known to having great Spanish restaurants

We tried Pizza Luna not long after it opened and my impression was that it was good but probably would not become a place we regularly got pizza from. However we were looking for a place to order lunch from at work and decided to get Pizza Luna now that they deliver and wow is it delicious. Easily some of the best pizza I've had in Tucson between the crust and the toppings.

We got a large Neapolitan pizza to go. Pretty fast service; our pizza was done in about 15 minutes. The pizza sauce was flavorful with a good garlic flavor. The pizza base was a thin crust that was soft with a good chew. The crust itself was light and airy. There was a good amount of cheese too, not too heavy and didn't cover the whole pie. Not greasy at all. It's definitely the kind of pizza you can eat a lot of slices of and it feel crappy about yourself. Our pizza without toppings was $21 so definitely could get pricy if you added toppings. We saw their happy hour was from 2-5pm with a slice only being $2.25 and a slice with an alcoholic drink (wine/beer) for like ~$8? They also had a lunch special until 5pm for a salad and slice for $8! Pretty great deals, so I would definitely return for those!
I know it is for the kids, but the games are double what Chuck e Cheese  cost and the pizza dough tastes frozen. That is what happens when big corporate take over, it is all about the bottom line.

although this store is more geared towards needlepoint and I'm more of a cross-stitcher, they use a lot of the same materials and I found a lot here that I loved. they have an amazing selection of pretty much every type of embroidery floss, threads, and ribbon that you could ever want. the prices for some of the fancier things are a little steep, but I wouldn't say they're overpriced - it's just how it is. 

they also have some pre-made needlepoint designs - the kind where the design is drawn right on the canvas. like I said, I'm more of a cross stitcher and I like making my own patterns so I didn't look through all of them when I was in the store, but they're all kind of...grandma-esque. which I guess goes along with the needlepoint-store territory. I did get a really cool little book with old French-style letters and monograms that I've used a lot.

the owners/employees are all really nice and helpful (although I got canvas instead of aida cloth, which was my mistake - I was still a little overwhelmed by how much STUFF was in the store...and I did have to wait a few minutes before being helped but that was because they were busy with other customers) and there was an adorable standard poodle up there both times I've gone. to get into the store, you have to ring a buzzer and enter through the building lobby.

they also have monthly and weekly classes - I've been meaning to check them out with a friend, but, you know, life. and also a bit of hesitation knowing that I would probably be the youngest person there by a lot.

ANYWAY, to finish this up - much better than going to Pearl. cross-stitch is awesome and I don't give a shit if that makes me a 60-year-old grandma.

We decided to come here on a Friday night after hearing friends telling us how good the pizza was and so glad we did...the pizza was top notch as you could tell they used the finest ingredients, "NV Meatballs"  were an excellent appetizer and the cinnamon toast crunch" was a sinfully good dessert.  If you want great pizza, this is the place!

I ordered my pizza online and within 15 minutes, I was headed back home even though the place was bustling. The meat was crispy yet tender and the fig balsamic ratio is always a win. Delicious! With tip, the small fig, pig, goat pizza came out to almost $20. So more expensive but very good.

I have mixed feelings about this vet. First thing to make clear: this is NOT a low cost clinic - it couldn't even be described as affordable. The location and facilities might lead you to believe it would be affordable. It did me. I live in the Fairmount neighborhood, and I ruled out The Cat Doctor, also in my hood, figuring this humble-looking clinic on West Girard would be a more affordable option. But the truth is, every time I go there, I pay at least $400 for my two cats. AT LEAST $400 and EVERY SINGLE TIME. It's very stressful for someone that loves her cats like humans but is generally worried about money. They do a lot of blood work, urine samples, you name it. I went in for yearly shots yesterday and my total was $425 on account of they found like 6 other things they had to do. I still haven't gotten the $1400 in dental work they recommended during my first visit.

I'm not the only one who gets stressed out by this vet. The waiting room is tiny, which has the effect of freaking out my cats when giant dogs come barging in, but also of making one privy to the anguish of other customers as they get they get their bill. Yesterday a man that walked in smiling with his sweet Shitzu, upon hearing what he would owe, barged out of the exam room and immediately out the clinic doors yelling, "YOU CAN KEEP THE DAMN DOG." I giggled in solidarity with the receptionists, who undoubtedly bear the brunt of such frustrations, but the truth was, I related with the Shitzu dad. A part of me yells something similar in my head every time I get the bill at Girard Vet. 

Like another reviewer posted, they will not share your prescription for food with 3rd parties. Meaning that you have to buy the prescription food from them. Even though it's cheaper elsewhere.  If they wanted to build good faith with their customers, this is one practice I believe they should rethink.

So why do I keep going? The truth is, they are thorough, and I think that Dr. Wilkerson is very skilled and knowledgable. They helped me through one of my kitties' reoccurring bladder problems with solutions other vets never provided. She ended up having surgery and you could tell from the incision site that it was performed by expert hands.  I will likely take the girls somewhere else for the dental work, since I know from checking around that GV's prices are much higher. But for the basics I will likely begrudgingly stick with Girard Vet for the remainder of the time I live in the neighborhood.
The pizza is great but at 850 they canceled my order out of nowhere!!! I have been waiting for 50 minutes!!!!!

I just moved to Tucson from the New Jersey /New York area so I know how I like my pizza. This place is amazing if you have a craving for pizza definitely go here every time I've got pizza here the quality is perfect and everyone in the restaurant is super friendly and the place is very modern clean and stylish. I highly recommend this restaurant to everyone.
Their pizza is delicious! Quality ingredients, their crust was delicious, and their prices were reasonable. My whole party loved it. My favorite was the artichoke and olive pizza.

while the pizza is good tasting, the place itself is a different story. I'm not sure if it's just way overcrowded when we went here or it's the norm. My son somewhat didn't really get to enjoy this place because it's way packed and there's not really enough games/arcades to go around. The coin machine only takes cash, so i wasn't able to purchase additional tokens that day, Bummer!. We might just come back here whenever it starts to settle down a little, but i don't know when will that be.
Great service and great pizza. We always stop by when we're on the east side. Online ordering is very simple and ready when requested.

Lunch in this historic Wissahickon setting is perfect in any season.  The restaurant is set at water's edge, amidst winding trails.  Enjoy nature as you head toward the parking lots. The menu is interesting and prepared well. The burger is solid and fresh.  Mushroom Bisque- local recipe, brimming with flavor.  Take some time to browse the art and learn the history.  You'll return, like I have, repeatedly.

A cool little joint with excellent Dominican fare. The mofongo was on the money - reminded me of mofongo at Adrian Tropical in Santo Domingo proper. The service was awesome and all the food was great. Check this little joint out - it will not disappoint!!!

Some people may review this place negatively because they simply don't know!

Traveling through Tucson and I wanted some pizza so I found this place. The guys behind the counter were really friendly and I placed my order and went next-door to Trader Joe's for a few minutes since they told me it would be a few before the pizza was ready. Then I came back and it was ready in about five minutes. Then I grabbed the two sodas that I had ordered out of the counter refrigerator and the guy gave me a bit of a hard time about me reaching in there and grabbing my sodas because this is a COVID-19 world and I should not have touched it. They had me feeling really great about everything in the world until that moment. I gave them five stars because the pizza was awesome but I did not need someone talking to me like I'm a child.  He could've just let it go and not say anything. What he actually told me was that the next time I come in let them get the soda for me since "they're all gloved up."  I guess he forgot that I told him I was visiting from the other side of the country and I would never be back again. So please go to this place... Support local business... Eat great pizza... And when you order your drinks just reach in and grab the darn things!
Good food, fast delivery, can't ask for much more.  I ordered egg foo young, won ton soup and egg rolls. I'm not very risky in my choices but everything was hot and quickly delivered.

Searching for a quick bite and came here because a place up the street closed. Ordered a Sausage Rossa and it's delicious!!! Wish I had found this place sooner! Will definitely be making this a regular stop! Delicious sauce, perfect crust and the lemonade is top notch

I called this salon because it was rated best for color services in Philadelphia. While playing the telephone game with the receptionist (answering my questions by putting me on hold and running over to the stylist) I experienced harsh comments geared at getting me NOT to come in. I finally got the stylist on and this treatment continued even going there with old checking to see if I can pay act (I'm a doctor). I eventually stated that even if the color can't be done, because I have an event, I would definitely want to leave with at least a wash a blowout. I was then told, "then you should find another salon". Is this because the photos I was made to send ahead revealed that I was African American? I've been getting keratin for 7 years, now it's suddenly dangerous for hair? Gross treatment! Discrimination!
Homemade Dominican cuisine made with LOVE. I feel right at home here. The owner and staff are so hospitable. They have an array of options that are sure to satisfy the palate.

Good food ! And drinks . Well , I sipped my sister's coffee because I will be jumping off the walls if I had one to myself , but they have great tea ! 

I had a burger for brunch (I know. Super awesome of me eh?!) and it was great!! Wasn't a fan of the potatoes that came with though. Burger was juicy and cooked perfectly the way I like it. We also ordered waffles which was devoured in 2 seconds because my boyfriend eats a lot and two waffles didn't do anything for him. 

Service is awesome. Everyone is very sweet and helpful, however, don't expect to get seated right away during Sunday brunch (when do you ever during brunch?!). 

I live a block from this place and I think it's a pretty cool place to check out during a random Tuesday noon stroll.

Best neighbors ever. No complaints yet.

OH! They actually forgot my egg roll last time. But if they keep the record of screwing up 1 out of every 89239844 times. You're AOK in my book.

Wow! This pizza place is freaking fantastic! The service was wonderful. Wish we lived here so we can enjoy this place on our weekly pizza nights. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for tasty Italian food. Thank you!!
